items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: A collapsible panel: a pointer clicks the header, the chevron turns and the content unfolds, then it closes again.

items.name: accordion-unfold
items.title: Accordion Unfold
items.description: A tight paper zigzag unfolds sideways into a flat card with the logo printed across it. The placeholder lockup is a stand-in: a host prints its own logo by replacing the .au-print contents in the script.

items.name: add-to-cart-button
items.title: Add To Cart Button
items.description: A button is pressed and squashes; a shirt pops out of its top, drops into a cart icon that ticks and drives off to the right while the label returns, with morphing shapes and an elastic settle.

items.name: agent-run
items.title: Agent Run
items.description: A brand-neutral AI agent run that thinks, calls tools against a real-seconds timer and streams a markdown answer in bursts.

items.name: agent-terminal
items.title: Agent Terminal
items.description: An unbranded coding-agent terminal: the window or launcher eases in, panels fade up and a task types itself into the prompt with a blinking caret.

items.name: ai-answer-rank
items.title: AI Answer Rank
items.description: A question types into a chat card, the assistant answers with a ranked list of three picks, then re-ranks: the promoted brand slides into its slot, the picks below step down, and the brand row lands with an accent highlight and a check.

items.name: ai-prompt-composer
items.title: AI Prompt Composer
items.description: An unbranded AI chat composer: the greeting and input ease in, a prompt types itself and the voice button morphs into the send button while the suggestion chips fade.

items.name: ai-prompt-flow
items.title: AI Prompt Flow
items.description: A full prompt-to-answer scene: the prompt types itself, the button runs to loading, a skeleton shimmers, the answer crossfades in and a toast confirms.

items.name: ai-text-loading
items.title: AI Text Loading
items.description: A cycling status word whose letters blur in one by one while a soft brightness wave runs through them: the look of an AI that is working.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A destructive confirmation: a pointer clicks Delete account, a dimmed alert dialog scales in and the Delete button is pressed.

items.name: anamorphic-flare
items.title: Anamorphic Flare
items.description: A point of light stretches into a cinematic horizontal streak that sweeps the frame and reveals the logo behind it. The placeholder lockup is a stand-in: a host swaps in its own logo by editing the .af-logo element.

items.name: animated-bar-chart
items.title: Animated Bar Chart
items.description: Bars spring up from the baseline with a staggered cascade.

items.name: animated-gradient-text
items.title: Animated Gradient Text
items.description: Text filled with a wide three-colour gradient that drifts slowly from one end to the other and back, so the colours flow through the letters.

items.name: animated-line-chart
items.title: Animated Line Chart
items.description: A line chart whose path draws on from left to right with a glowing leading dot.

items.name: ascii-dissolve
items.title: ASCII Dissolve
items.description: The frame turns into plain text: a field of monospace characters rises over the outgoing scene, flows as living ASCII, then dissolves cell by cell into the incoming scene. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .asd-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: ascii-render
items.title: ASCII Render
items.description: A scene redrawn as text, one character per cell chosen by the cell's brightness, in green ink or in the scene's own colours. Runs its WebGL shader over its own built-in scene (a stat and a bar chart; label, number and bars from variables), not over the host video.

items.name: aurora
items.title: Aurora
items.description: Green and violet aurora curtains ripple across a night sky.

items.name: aurora-text
items.title: Aurora Text
items.description: Four-colour gradient text whose colours drift slowly through the letters, magenta to violet to blue to cyan by default, set after a plain lead-in word.

items.name: backdrop
items.title: Backdrop
items.description: Full-frame colour or gradient fill with a padded, rounded, shadowed content frame (the floating-card look). Frame holds a built-in placeholder.

items.name: bauhaus-build
items.title: Bauhaus Build
items.description: Geometric Bauhaus pieces tumble in, snap into a composition, then tumble away again.

items.name: beat-title-cards
items.title: Beat Title Cards
items.description: Kinetic title cards that cut on a beat. Every beat swaps the word with a crisp snap scale, every few beats a card is inverted for emphasis, and the last word stays on screen. The words cycle from one variable and the cut rate follows the bpm variable, so it can be laid on music.

items.name: before-after-wipe
items.title: Before After Wipe
items.description: Two panels labelled Sebelum and Sesudah. A divider handle sweeps from the before side to the after side and settles near the middle while the two labels swap emphasis as it passes. The panels are drawn placeholders (two tones and a simple jar) or your own two images.

items.name: blueprint
items.title: Blueprint
items.description: A product wipes left to right into a technical drawing with a blueprint grid, white linework, dimension lines and a red callout. A built-in red device stands in for the product; labels and colors are variables.

items.name: blur-in
items.title: Blur In
items.description: A single element is revealed with blur, opacity and a directional offset, settling in place: a premium entrance for a card, image or composed scene.

items.name: blur-out-up
items.title: Blur Out Up
items.description: Words arrive clean and depart upward with increasing blur for airy exits.

items.name: blur-reveal
items.title: Blur Reveal
items.description: A transition: the outgoing scene softens away while the incoming one resolves out of blur, with a faint scale drift.

items.name: bottom-up-letters
items.title: Bottom-Up Letters
items.description: Letters rise from below in a pronounced staircase, one symbol at a time.

items.name: brand-guidelines
items.title: Brand Guidelines
items.description: A complete editorial identity film: a geometric brand mark, a terracotta, graphite, stone and paper palette, a type specimen that types and deletes itself through eight styles, a layered collage of drawn object plates, and three flipping tiles that become the closing wordmark. Silent: sound is added by the host. The object photos are drawn with SVG by default; pass image paths to use real photographs.

items.name: breathing-text
items.title: Breathing Text
items.description: Letters flex between two variable-font settings (weight and slant) in a staggered, mirrored loop, so the word appears to breathe.

items.name: brick-mosaic
items.title: Brick Mosaic
items.description: Toy bricks drop in row by row from the bottom with a small bounce and build a pixel-art image on a baseplate. Give it a pixel-art grid as text in the pattern variable, or leave it empty for a built-in red disc.

items.name: bundle-builder
items.title: Bundle Builder
items.description: Three or four product tiles drop one by one into an open box while the total counts up, then a "Hemat" badge lands on the box and the total steps down to the bundle price. Products, prices and the saving are variables.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A button that plays its whole lifecycle: a pointer arrives, the button hovers, presses, shows a spinner, then a check.

items.name: camera-lens
items.title: Camera Lens
items.description: A scene seen through a lens instead of rendered flat: softness growing toward the corners, bright text blooming, red and blue fringing at the edges, a gentle barrel bend and a falloff in the light. Runs its WebGL shader over its own built-in scene (a render queue list; title, rows and background from variables), not over the host video. Subtle enough to leave running under a whole shot.

items.name: caption-active-pop
items.title: Caption Active Pop
items.description: The word being spoken turns to the accent color and springs up in scale, then settles back as the voice moves on.

items.name: caption-blur-in
items.title: Caption Blur In
items.description: Each word resolves out of a soft blur the moment it is spoken, for captions that arrive quietly.

items.name: caption-bounce-in
items.title: Caption Bounce In
items.description: Each word springs up into place with a little overshoot the moment it is spoken, and the phrase builds word by word.

items.name: caption-cube
items.title: Caption Cube
items.description: Each new phrase turns into view as the next face of a 3D cube, the previous phrase rotating up and away on a horizontal hinge.

items.name: caption-dim-progress
items.title: Caption Dim Progress
items.description: The whole phrase sits on screen dimmed and each word brightens the moment it is spoken, with no motion at all.

items.name: caption-drop
items.title: Caption Drop
items.description: Each word falls into place from above and bounces as it lands the moment it is spoken, and the whole phrase drops out of frame when the speaker pauses.

items.name: caption-emoji
items.title: Caption Emoji
items.description: An emoji pops up above a chosen word the moment it is spoken and stays until the phrase leaves.

items.name: caption-emoji-beat
items.title: Caption Emoji Beat
items.description: Emoji stamps land on the beat over a caption line: each arrives with overshoot, wobbles once, holds, then releases.

items.name: caption-handwrite
items.title: Caption Handwrite
items.description: Each word is inked in by hand from left to right at the pace it is spoken, every word sitting at its own slight angle.

items.name: caption-highlight-box
items.title: Caption Highlight Box
items.description: A solid box travels behind the word being spoken, sliding from word to word as the voice moves on.

items.name: caption-karaoke
items.title: Caption Karaoke
items.description: Each word fills with color left to right exactly as it is spoken, with the whole phrase readable before the voice reaches it.

items.name: caption-knockout
items.title: Caption Knockout
items.description: A solid plate with the words cut clean through it, each word punching out the moment it is spoken so the footage shows through the letters.

items.name: caption-label-maker
items.title: Caption Label Maker
items.description: Each phrase is punched letter by letter into a strip of embossing tape at the pace it is spoken, the tape feeding out as the words arrive.

items.name: caption-marker
items.title: Caption Marker
items.description: Plain captions where the words that matter get a highlighter swipe the moment they are spoken.

items.name: caption-outline
items.title: Caption Outline
items.description: Heavy-stroked captions that stay readable over any footage, with the spoken word switching to a contrast color and nothing else moving.

items.name: caption-prosody
items.title: Caption Prosody
items.description: Word size follows the delivery: drawn-out words land large and rushed words stay small, so the rhythm of the voice is visible with the sound off.

items.name: caption-redact
items.title: Caption Redact
items.description: The whole phrase starts blacked out like a declassified file, and each bar pulls away the moment its word is spoken.

items.name: caption-rise
items.title: Caption Rise
items.description: Each word slides up out of a mask at its baseline the moment it is spoken, with no bounce and no scale.

items.name: caption-scramble
items.title: Caption Scramble
items.description: Each word arrives as random glyphs at the moment it is spoken and decodes left to right into the real letters.

items.name: caption-slice
items.title: Caption Slice
items.description: Each word arrives cut in two, the top half sliding in from the left and the bottom from the right, locking together the moment it is spoken.

items.name: caption-slot
items.title: Caption Slot
items.description: One short line at a time, each new phrase rolling up into place as the previous one rolls out the top.

items.name: caption-speaker
items.title: Caption Speaker
items.description: Dialogue captions where every phrase takes its speaker's color, so a conversation reads like a script.

items.name: caption-split-flap
items.title: Caption Split Flap
items.description: Every letter sits on its own flap tile and clatters through a few characters before landing the moment the word is spoken, like a station departure board.

items.name: caption-stack
items.title: Caption Stack
items.description: Kinetic captions stacked a couple of words per line, with the keyword of each page set large on its own line.

items.name: caption-stamp
items.title: Caption Stamp
items.description: Plain captions where the words that matter slam down as a rubber stamp the moment they are spoken.

items.name: caption-subtitle
items.title: Caption Subtitle
items.description: Classic broadcast subtitles: a whole phrase on a translucent plate, with no word-level animation at all.

items.name: caption-teleprompter
items.title: Caption Teleprompter
items.description: The whole transcript scrolls smoothly through a short window with the current line centred, past lines fading above and the next line waiting below.

items.name: caption-timeline
items.title: Caption Timeline
items.description: The whole transcript laid out on a scrolling time strip that slides under a fixed playhead, so every pause shows up as space between words.

items.name: caption-typewriter
items.title: Caption Typewriter
items.description: Each word types out character by character at the pace it is spoken, with a caret that blinks while the speaker pauses.

items.name: caption-underline
items.title: Caption Underline
items.description: A bar slides under the word being spoken, travelling from word to word while the text itself stays untouched.

items.name: caption-weight
items.title: Caption Weight
items.description: The word being spoken swells from a light weight to a heavy one and relaxes as the voice moves on, with no layout shift.

items.name: caption-word-pop
items.title: Caption Word Pop
items.description: One large word at a time, each popping in on a spring the moment it is spoken.

items.name: caret
items.title: Caret
items.description: A blinking text caret: a thin rounded bar that flips on and off, sitting after a line of text.

items.name: caret-swap
items.title: Caret Swap
items.description: A gradient caret expands into a block that consumes the first text, then types the second.

items.name: caret-wipe
items.title: Caret Wipe
items.description: A tall text caret sweeps across the frame: behind it the new scene is typed in, ahead of it the old scene is backspaced away. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .crw-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: carousel-circle-1
items.title: Circle Carousel
items.description: Cards ride a tilted circle, large at the front and small behind, and sweep round in a fast-slow-fast swing. Product cards are drawn (gradient panel, glyph, title from a list); an optional images variable swaps in photos.

items.name: carousel-circle-3
items.title: Circle Carousel, Open Arc
items.description: Cards fill about two thirds of a ring in an open arc, evenly sized and stacked edge to edge, and swing round fast. Product cards are drawn (gradient panel, glyph, title from a list); an optional images variable swaps in photos.

items.name: carousel-circle-4
items.title: Circle Carousel, Tilted Ring
items.description: A wide, tilted ring of cards drifting slowly, the near cards large and the far cards tiny. Product cards are drawn (gradient panel, glyph, title from a list); an optional images variable swaps in photos.

items.name: carousel-circle-5
items.title: Circle Carousel, Big Cards
items.description: A dense ring of large overlapping cards with a steep size gradient, filling most of the frame. Product cards are drawn (gradient panel, glyph, title from a list); an optional images variable swaps in photos.

items.name: carousel-orbit-1
items.title: Orbit Carousel
items.description: Cards sit on a sphere that spins about its vertical axis, each card turned to face the camera, near cards larger. Product cards are drawn (gradient panel, glyph, title from a list); an optional images variable swaps in photos.

items.name: carousel-orbit-2
items.title: Orbit Carousel, Tilted Sphere
items.description: A denser sphere of cards turned a quarter turn, so the spin runs sideways across the frame. Product cards are drawn (gradient panel, glyph, title from a list); an optional images variable swaps in photos.

items.name: carousel-orbit-3
items.title: Orbit Carousel, Rolling Sphere
items.description: A wide sphere of cards that rolls forward about its horizontal axis rather than spinning sideways. Product cards are drawn (gradient panel, glyph, title from a list); an optional images variable swaps in photos.

items.name: carousel-orbit-4
items.title: Orbit Carousel, Compact Sphere
items.description: A small, tight sphere of cards that spins on a tilted axis. Product cards are drawn (gradient panel, glyph, title from a list); an optional images variable swaps in photos.

items.name: carousel-orbit-5
items.title: Orbit Carousel, Column
items.description: Cards stacked along a vertical column that spins, near cards overlapping the far ones. Product cards are drawn (gradient panel, glyph, title from a list); an optional images variable swaps in photos.

items.name: carousel-path-1
items.title: Path Carousel, Arc
items.description: Cards ride a wide arc that curls round the frame, near cards large and far cards small. Product cards are drawn (gradient panel, glyph, title from a list); an optional images variable swaps in photos.

items.name: carousel-path-2
items.title: Path Carousel, Valley
items.description: Cards run down one side of a V-shaped track and up the other, bunching at the bottom. Product cards are drawn (gradient panel, glyph, title from a list); an optional images variable swaps in photos.

items.name: carousel-path-3
items.title: Path Carousel, Diagonal
items.description: Cards climb a gently curved diagonal track, tipping slightly as they go. Product cards are drawn (gradient panel, glyph, title from a list); an optional images variable swaps in photos.

items.name: carousel-path-4
items.title: Path Carousel, Wave
items.description: Cards follow an S-shaped wave, large at the crests and tiny in the dip, turning with the track. Product cards are drawn (gradient panel, glyph, title from a list); an optional images variable swaps in photos.

items.name: carousel-path-5
items.title: Path Carousel, Ribbon
items.description: A dense ribbon of cards along a long S-curve, tilted strongly to follow the track. Product cards are drawn (gradient panel, glyph, title from a list); an optional images variable swaps in photos.

items.name: carousel-text-circle-1
items.title: Text and Circle Carousel
items.description: A headline reveals word by word while a ring of cards converges from off-frame and threads the line, collapses to the centre, then hard-cuts to a closing line that settles in. Product cards are drawn (gradient panel, glyph, title from a list); an optional images variable swaps in photos.

items.name: carousel-text-circle-3
items.title: Text and Circle Carousel, Open Arc
items.description: Same headline reveal and cut as carousel-text-circle-1, with an open arc of evenly sized cards that swings round fast. Product cards are drawn (gradient panel, glyph, title from a list); an optional images variable swaps in photos.

items.name: carousel-text-circle-4
items.title: Text and Circle Carousel, Tilted Ring
items.description: Same headline reveal and cut as carousel-text-circle-1, with a slow wide tilted ring. Product cards are drawn (gradient panel, glyph, title from a list); an optional images variable swaps in photos.

items.name: carousel-text-circle-5
items.title: Text and Circle Carousel, Big Cards
items.description: Same headline reveal and cut as carousel-text-circle-1, with big overlapping cards. Product cards are drawn (gradient panel, glyph, title from a list); an optional images variable swaps in photos.

items.name: carousel-vision-1
items.title: Vision Carousel
items.description: Cards ride a ring that is tilted in 3D around a point below the centre, so they swing past the camera with a fan of perspective. Product cards are drawn (gradient panel, glyph, title from a list); an optional images variable swaps in photos.

items.name: carousel-vision-2
items.title: Vision Carousel, Face On
items.description: Cards slide past in a wide band, turned face on, with perspective only at the ends. The ring tilt and card fan are variables. Product cards are drawn (gradient panel, glyph, title from a list); an optional images variable swaps in photos.

items.name: carousel-vision-3
items.title: Vision Carousel, Tipped
items.description: The face-on band tipped sideways, so the far side of the ring tilts away and the cards skew. Product cards are drawn (gradient panel, glyph, title from a list); an optional images variable swaps in photos.

items.name: carousel-vision-5
items.title: Vision Carousel, Strip
items.description: A fast, shallow strip of cards that runs left to right with a slight fan. Product cards are drawn (gradient panel, glyph, title from a list); an optional images variable swaps in photos.

items.name: centered-word-build
items.title: Centered Word Build
items.description: Words appear sharply from below while the centered phrase pushes closer on every beat.

items.name: chat-flow
items.title: Chat Flow
items.description: A messaging conversation: outgoing messages type into the composer and send, typing dots precede replies, and reactions pop onto bubbles.

items.name: chat-review-typed
items.title: Chat Review Typed
items.description: A headline with the shop name on its own line, a customer's avatar and name, an incoming bubble with typing dots that then writes the review letter by letter, a dark reply bubble sliding in from the right, five stars with a score line, and a call-to-action pill. White page, hairline bubbles.

items.name: chat-to-preview-layout
items.title: Chat to Preview Layout
items.description: A two-up split where the chat panel shrinks and the preview panel expands, to show an agent building something. Both panels hold generic placeholder content. On a tall frame the split stacks vertically (chat on top).

items.name: check-list
items.title: Check List
items.description: A handwritten checklist that writes itself out, then ticks and strikes through every done item.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A checkbox that a pointer ticks and unticks: the box fills with the primary color and the check draws in.

items.name: checkout-flow
items.title: Checkout Flow
items.description: A cursor-driven checkout card: pick the yearly plan, type a card number, accept the terms, pay, and a toast confirms.

items.name: chromatic-radial-split
items.title: Chromatic Radial Split
items.description: RGB channels separate and converge radially. From-scene splits outward, to-scene converges inward. Plays between two built-in panels (A and B) that a host swaps for its own scenes: copy the fragment shader into your composition and feed it your two frames as textures.

items.name: chromatic-wave
items.title: Chromatic Wave
items.description: A soft wave travels down through the type; where it crosses, the letters ripple and split into RGB fringes, then settle back to white.

items.name: cinematic-zoom
items.title: Cinematic Zoom
items.description: Both scenes zoom-blur with per-channel radial offset. From zooms outward, to zooms inward from tight. Plays between two built-in panels (A and B) that a host swaps for its own scenes: copy the fragment shader into your composition and feed it your two frames as textures.

items.name: circular-text
items.title: Circular Text
items.description: Characters sit evenly around a circle and the whole ring spins steadily, like a badge or a stamp.

items.name: clay-liquid-columns
items.title: Clay Liquid Columns
items.description: Five frosted-glass columns fill with coloured liquid that overshoots and settles with an elastic bounce, a percentage counting up above each, while a chunky clay-style info card with an icon pops in below every column.

items.name: cloth-reveal
items.title: Cloth Reveal
items.description: A satin sheet draped over your content is yanked from one corner, folding and fluttering as a simulated cloth before it clears the frame. The Verlet simulation runs once at load with a fixed timestep and a seeded rest shape (a 32×20 grid), every frame's points are stored, and the timeline only draws the stored frame. The content under the sheet is a neutral lockup with editable text.

items.name: code-3d-extrude
items.title: Code 3D Extrude
items.description: A syntax-highlighted code card on a thick lit slab: it swings in from an angle, settles face-on with a cool key light and a green rim light on its edges, and then drifts a little at rest. WebGL.

items.name: code-editor-typing
items.title: Code Editor Typing
items.description: A full code editor window (activity bar, explorer, tabs, terminal, status bar) types a snippet character by character with a caret, then tilts in 3D.

items.name: code-morph
items.title: Code Morph
items.description: A code panel morphs between versions of a file: surviving tokens glide to their new line and column, removed code blurs out and new code fades in. The clip is 4.6 s long for the default two versions and 36-frame morph.

items.name: code-particle-assemble
items.title: Code Particle Assemble
items.description: A snippet of highlighted code assembles out of thousands of particles: each lit pixel of the text flies in from a seeded scatter in 3D, white and bright in flight, and lands in its true syntax colour. WebGL points.

items.name: code-shader-dissolve
items.title: Code Shader Dissolve
items.description: A code snippet appears through a noise dissolve: a glowing cyan edge with a small colour fringe sweeps over the card as the syntax-highlighted lines resolve, then the card holds crisp. WebGL shader over a card the block draws from a code variable.

items.name: code-slice-hero
items.title: Code Slice Hero
items.description: A square-tiled headline surface where a sweeping depth field flips tile by tile to reveal a rear headline. Raw WebGL2, instanced tiles with cast shadows.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A searchable select: the panel opens, a query types itself, the list narrows, and the matching row is picked.

items.name: comic-panels
items.title: Comic Panels
items.description: The frame cracks into a three-panel comic page with speed lines and halftone, then the action panel bursts into a full-frame word such as POW. A built-in lockup stands in for the hero; a host replaces the contents of the .cp-hero layer with its own logo or headline.

items.name: comic-text
items.title: Comic Text
items.description: Comic-book lettering: skewed uppercase letters with a halftone-dot fill, a heavy black outline and a stacked hard shadow, popping in with a small overshoot.

items.name: command-menu
items.title: Command Menu
items.description: A keyboard-driven command palette: the backdrop dims, a query types itself, the list filters, and the first row is picked.

items.name: command-menu-item
items.title: Command Menu Item
items.description: One command palette row going idle, hover, press and selected as the cursor reaches it and clicks.

items.name: confetti
items.title: Confetti
items.description: A deterministic burst of confetti pieces that fall, spin and flutter with gravity.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A right-click menu that opens at the cursor over a file card, then an item is hovered, pressed and the menu closes.

items.name: cosmic-orb
items.title: Cosmic Orb
items.description: An iridescent soap-bubble planet: a slowly spinning sphere of nebula bands, dust lanes and twinkling stars wrapped in a refracting glass limb with chromatic aberration at the edge. A single WebGL fragment shader.

items.name: cradle-text
items.title: Cradle Text
items.description: Letters hang from a rail like a Newton's cradle: the first is pulled out and released, the knock runs through the row and the last letter swings out.

items.name: cross-warp-morph
items.title: Cross-Warp Morph
items.description: Both scenes displace along a shared FBM noise field in opposite directions. Noise-driven blend boundary. Plays between two built-in panels (A and B) that a host swaps for its own scenes: copy the fragment shader into your composition and feed it your two frames as textures.

items.name: crt-screen
items.title: CRT Screen
items.description: A scene behind curved tube glass: barrel distortion, an RGB phosphor mask, scanlines that bow with the picture, bloom around bright text and corners that run off into black. Runs its WebGL shader over its own built-in scene (a render queue list; title, rows and background from variables), not over the host video. The only motion is a 1 % brightness breath, so it holds as a look.

items.name: crumple-toss
items.title: Crumple Toss
items.description: A card crumples into a paper wad in stop-motion poses and is tossed into a bin: the old way, thrown away.

items.name: cursor
items.title: Cursor
items.description: An animated mouse pointer that follows a scripted path to a button, clicks it with a ripple, and the button shows hover, press, loading and success.

items.name: cursor-gravity
items.title: Cursor Gravity
items.description: A rounded triangular cursor tugs a button out of the screen edge with pulsed elastic resistance.

items.name: dia-text-reveal
items.title: Dia Text Reveal
items.description: A soft multi-colour gradient band sweeps left to right across the text, revealing the letters behind it; with several texts it then swaps to the next and sweeps again.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal dialog: a pointer clicks a trigger, the scrim dims the frame and the dialog scales in; clicking Save closes it.

items.name: dish-menu-morph
items.title: Dish Menu Morph
items.description: A menu page that cycles through three dishes: a three-line icon morphs into the next dish's line art, the headline letters slide out and in, the dish illustration flies off at 45 degrees and back, and the menu items slide up with their prices.

items.name: displacement
items.title: Displacement
items.description: The frame shears into a grid of tiles that slide out of register with red/blue fringing and film grain, swap to the next scene mid-slide, then settle back. Runs its WebGL shader over two built-in panels (a stat and a bar chart, then a render queue; text and colours from variables), not over the host's scenes: 45 frames of the first panel, a 18-frame transition, then the second panel. To use it between your own scenes, copy the shader into your composition and feed it your two frames as textures.

items.name: dither-dissolve
items.title: Dither Dissolve
items.description: A two-color ordered-dither pattern rises over the outgoing scene, holds, and falls away to reveal the next one. Rebuilt with a deterministic Canvas 2D Bayer dither instead of the original WebGL shader. The block draws its own colored field between two built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .dtd-panel elements); to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: dock-text
items.title: Dock Text
items.description: A pointer glides across a line of capitals and the letters near it stretch tall like a dock, the nearest one most, easing back to size when the pointer leaves.

items.name: dolly-zoom
items.title: Dolly Zoom
items.description: The vertigo shot: a corridor with a red door stretches deeper while the subject in the middle keeps its exact size. A host puts its own subject in by replacing the .dz-subject svg with its own centered content.

items.name: domain-warp-dissolve
items.title: Domain Warp Dissolve
items.description: Cascaded fbm(p + fbm(p)) displaces both scenes along a warp field. Iridescent cosine-palette edge glow. Plays between two built-in panels (A and B) that a host swaps for its own scenes: copy the fragment shader into your composition and feed it your two frames as textures.

items.name: dot-silhouette-morph
items.title: Dot Silhouette Morph
items.description: Two hundred and fifty dots gather at the centre, then flow through a series of outlines (circle, heart, star, house) in a rippling stagger on a sine ease, each dot pulsing in size as it goes.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A bottom panel: a pointer clicks a trigger inside a mock app window, the scrim dims it and a drawer rises from the bottom; clicking Save closes it.

items.name: drift
items.title: Drift
items.description: A slow constant camera push-in, so no scene is ever frozen. Plays on a built-in placeholder scene.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: An action menu: a pointer clicks the trigger, the menu drops open, a row is hovered and pressed, then the menu closes.

items.name: dropdown-menu-item
items.title: Dropdown Menu Item
items.description: A menu row: a pointer hovers it and presses it, inside a small action menu.

items.name: duotone-beat
items.title: Duotone Beat
items.description: A two-ink halftone portrait that swaps its ink pair on every beat, punches in on the downbeat and shows a bar indicator. A built-in silhouette stands in for the photo; a host replaces the contents of the .db-picture layer with its own image.

items.name: dynamic-text
items.title: Dynamic Text
items.description: Word-to-word morph where letters are physical: shared letters glide to their new spot on a spring arc, others fall away, new ones drop in and land with a squash.

items.name: echo-stack
items.title: Echo Stack
items.description: A word focuses in at the center while outline copies of it unfold above and below and keep drifting, like the one clear line on a spinning drum.

items.name: ecosystem-constellation
items.title: Ecosystem Constellation
items.description: A central product mark orbited by integration satellites with pulsing data lines. The eight satellites are generic placeholder marks, not real brands.

items.name: ember-burn
items.title: Ember Burn
items.description: The outgoing frame is set on fire: a noisy burn front eats the bright parts first, the edge boils and glows, charred rims fall away and sparks drift off carrying the frame's colour, uncovering the next scene. Runs its WebGL shader over two built-in panels (a stat and a bar chart, then a render queue; text and colours from variables), not over the host's scenes: 60 frames of the first panel, a 40-frame transition, then the second panel. To use it between your own scenes, copy the shader into your composition and feed it your two frames as textures.

items.name: event-countdown-clock
items.title: Event Countdown Clock
items.description: A T− clock in four cells (days, hours, minutes, seconds) in a hairline panel under a title that wipes in. The days and hours race down, the last five seconds tick in real time with a ten-segment bar emptying each second, then the clock turns to the accent colour, flips to T+, and a short "now" line takes the title's place.

items.name: exploded-stack
items.title: Exploded Stack
items.description: Isometric layer plates sit as one stack, explode apart along the vertical axis with labels drawing in beside each layer, hold, then collapse back so the clip loops. Four layers with their own glyph motifs and an accent colour.

items.name: exploded-view
items.title: Exploded View
items.description: An isometric stack of slabs springs apart with leader lines and labels, holds, then clicks back together.

items.name: extrude-pop
items.title: Extrude Pop
items.description: A flat word pops up out of the plane on a solid colored 3D body, no camera involved.

items.name: fade-through
items.title: Fade Through
items.description: One text fades out and a second fades in with a slight rise, scale and blur, so scenes change calmly.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A labelled form field: a label above, an input that focuses and types, helper text below, and a second filled field in the same group.

items.name: flash-sale-burst
items.title: Flash Sale Burst
items.description: A two-word headline rises in, a big percent figure bursts in and shakes once in the accent colour, two crossed running ribbons (black, and outlined) run their text in opposite directions and clear away, then the deadline is set in a bordered box. Clean white page, no starburst.

items.name: flash-through-white
items.title: Flash Through White
items.description: Both scenes brighten to a white midpoint. Works on dark backgrounds where color-dip-to-black is invisible. Plays between two built-in panels (A and B) that a host swaps for its own scenes: copy the fragment shader into your composition and feed it your two frames as textures.

items.name: flight-route-map
items.title: Flight Route Map
items.description: A plane flies a glowing route between two labelled pins over a drawn map, the camera drifts, the destination gets a hand-drawn circle and an arrival badge.

items.name: flow-field
items.title: Flow Field
items.description: Hundreds of particles ride a seeded, slowly changing vector field and leave fine fading trails, as a seamless loop.

items.name: focus-blur-resolve
items.title: Focus Blur Resolve
items.description: Text starts blurred and resolves to crisp, holds, then drifts up and blurs out.

items.name: focus-pull
items.title: Focus Pull
items.description: A rack focus between scenes: the outgoing scene defocuses and brightens, the incoming scene pulls into sharp focus. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .fcp-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: focus-pull-headline
items.title: Focus Pull Headline
items.description: A rack focus between two lines of text. A small context line starts sharp while the headline is a heavy blur; the focus pulls, the headline resolves to sharp and the context line drifts out of focus and dims. A thin accent line draws under the headline once it lands. Not a scene transition (see focus-pull) and not a single-text reveal (see focus-blur-resolve).

items.name: fog-rise
items.title: Fog Rise
items.description: Display text resolves out of fog center-out, sharpening from heavy blur as it tilts up on a spring.

items.name: folded-ribbon-steps
items.title: Folded Ribbon Steps
items.description: A five-step ribbon infographic: each front panel wipes up in turn, its folded back strip grows in behind it, and an arrowhead pops out of the last step with an elastic overshoot. Each step carries a number and a label.

items.name: follow-lower-third
items.title: Follow Lower Third
items.description: A pill-shaped profile bar slides up from the bottom, its Follow button is pressed and flips to Following, then the bar slides away.

items.name: followers-overview
items.title: Followers Overview
items.description: Follow notifications flip through in 3D, one name at a time, then the total follower count blurs in with a spring pop, the account handle and a confetti burst.

items.name: fomo-limit-orders
items.title: Order Flow
items.description: An 18.5-second trading-interface demo with fictional data, graphite surfaces and amber controls: three opening lines over drifting bars, a phone with a position card that the camera pushes into and orbits, a limit-order ticket whose slider contracts into a price field, a confirmation card, and the closing wordmark. Silent: sound is added by the host. All figures are illustrative.

items.name: font-weight-text
items.title: Font Weight Text
items.description: Letters breathe through a variable font weight, thin to heavy and back, each on its own phase so a wave of weight rolls along the word from the middle outward.

items.name: forum-post-card
items.title: Forum Post Card
items.description: A dark forum post card (community, author, title, body, vote and comment counts) rises in, gets an upvote with a spring and a count change, then drops out.

items.name: fruit-burst-reveal
items.title: Fruit Burst Reveal
items.description: A product reveal in one drawn scene: a line draws a circle and splashes droplets, a coloured fill sweeps diagonally across it, the core, stalk and leaf pop in with elastic overshoots, the whole piece wobbles, swells and bursts into particles before a caption rises.

items.name: gallery-tunnel
items.title: Gallery Tunnel
items.description: A flight down a rectangular corridor whose walls, floor and ceiling hold coloured slabs between thin edge mouldings, fading into fog: a continuous, loopable forward-motion backdrop. WebGL.

items.name: glass-code-block
items.title: Glass Code Block
items.description: A frosted-glass code editor window with a small regex colouring (plain spans, no highlighter library) and a line-by-line stagger reveal. Transparent, so it composites over any background.

items.name: glass-code-walk
items.title: Glass Code Walk
items.description: A camera that scans a frosted-glass code block top to bottom as its lines appear, then pulls back to a centred hold.

items.name: glass-hero
items.title: Glass Hero
items.description: A glass object rises in front of a giant headline and turns, bending the type: a lens or a ring with real refraction, a little colour dispersion, a tint and studio reflections on its edge. A subline fades in beneath.

items.name: glass-notification-aurora
items.title: Glass Notification Aurora
items.description: Two frosted-glass notification cards slide over a slowly moving aurora backdrop: one fills a progress bar and flips to done, the other types a reply.

items.name: glass-price-card
items.title: Glass Price Card
items.description: A frosted-glass card rises over a soft neutral backdrop: blur and a thin light border, no neon. The price counts up and settles, then a small badge lands on the corner.

items.name: glass-tube-gauges
items.title: Glass Tube Gauges
items.description: Five rounded glass tubes tilt up into place one after another, then fill with liquid that overshoots and settles with an elastic bounce, a bright meniscus riding the surface and a number counting up beneath each; afterwards the tubes bob gently.

items.name: glitch-cut
items.title: Glitch Cut
items.description: A hard cut torn into displaced horizontal slices with red/blue channel split and corrupted blocks that leak the other scene; each band hands over at its own moment. Runs its WebGL shader over two built-in panels (a stat and a bar chart, then a render queue; text and colours from variables), not over the host's scenes: 45 frames of the first panel, a 12-frame transition, then the second panel. To use it between your own scenes, copy the shader into your composition and feed it your two frames as textures.

items.name: glowing-route-lines
items.title: Glowing Route Lines
items.description: Three thin route lines with rounded corners enter from the frame edges; on each, a short stretch of the line draws and travels along it while a soft glow capsule rides ahead, aligned to the path, on a loop.

items.name: glyph-anatomy
items.title: Glyph Anatomy
items.description: A word builds as in a font editor, with metric guides, anchors along each contour and Bézier handles that pull straight segments into curves before the glyphs fill.

items.name: goal-ring-card
items.title: Goal Ring Card
items.description: A day-summary card: a ring fills to the share of a daily goal while the figure inside counts up, above a bar that restates the goal.

items.name: goo
items.title: Goo Orb
items.description: A glossy green liquid ball whose surface bulges and ripples like wet goo, centred on black.

items.name: gooey-morph
items.title: Gooey Morph
items.description: Bars fly in Tetris-style, land as a row, then melt into a word through a gooey blur-and-threshold morph.

items.name: gradient-scale-cut-text
items.title: Gradient Scale Cut Text
items.description: An oversized gradient reveal snaps to a compact blurred line that settles into focus.

items.name: gradual-spacing-text
items.title: Gradual Spacing Text
items.description: Letters drift in from the left and fade up one after another, so the line seems to space itself out gradually as it appears.

items.name: grain-dissolve
items.title: Grain Dissolve
items.description: A grainy gradient field blurs the outgoing scene away, fills the frame, and then clears to reveal the incoming scene. Rebuilt with a deterministic Canvas 2D gradient instead of the original WebGL shader. The block draws its own colored field between two built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .grd-panel elements); to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: gravitational-lens
items.title: Gravitational Lens
items.description: Content warps toward a gravity well with chromatic aberration and event horizon darkening. Plays between two built-in panels (A and B) that a host swaps for its own scenes: copy the fragment shader into your composition and feed it your two frames as textures.

items.name: gravity-pile
items.title: Gravity Pile
items.description: Seeded circles, squares and triangles rain down, bounce off the floor and each other, and settle into a heap, with optional words or emoji of your own landing on top.

items.name: grid-wave
items.title: Grid Wave
items.description: A wave crosses the frame (outward from the centre, or left, right, up or down) and lifts the picture into a grid of solid tiles with a gap between them, tinted and shaded as they rise, then sets them down carrying the next scene. Runs its WebGL shader over two built-in panels (a stat and a bar chart, then a render queue; text and colours from variables), not over the host's scenes: 60 frames of the first panel, a 36-frame transition, then the second panel. To use it between your own scenes, copy the shader into your composition and feed it your two frames as textures.

items.name: halftone-field
items.title: Halftone Field
items.description: A flowing noise field printed as a grid of dots: each cell holds one dot whose size follows the field, so only the crests open up against the background, in a four-stop palette. A single WebGL fragment shader.

items.name: halftone-print
items.title: Halftone Print
items.description: A scene printed instead of displayed: cyan, magenta and yellow dot screens at their own angles on warm paper, each plate a touch out of register. Runs its WebGL shader over its own built-in scene (a paper poster; kicker, headline and paragraph from variables), not over the host video. Best on light, graphic scenes with real midtones.

items.name: hand-count
items.title: Hand Count
items.description: A number that counts up in stop-motion poses, rewritten by hand at every pose.

items.name: handwrite
items.title: Handwrite
items.description: Handwritten text laid down letter by letter on a quantized stop-motion clock.

items.name: handwriting-text
items.title: Handwriting Text
items.description: Writes a string on, character by character, with a pen nib riding the wet edge of the ink and a slight hand-made tilt on every letter.

items.name: highlighter
items.title: Highlighter
items.description: A hand-drawn mark is scribbled over part of a sentence: marker highlight, underline, box, circle, strike-through, crossed-off or bracket, drawn stroke by stroke with a slightly wobbly line.

items.name: hologram
items.title: Hologram
items.description: A scene played as projected light: a ghost double shimmers off the image, emission lines structure it, a halo spills from bright areas, and everything leans toward its tint. WebGL.

items.name: holographic
items.title: Holographic Orb
items.description: An iridescent foil orb with a shifting rainbow sheen, centred on black.

items.name: hud-viewfinder
items.title: HUD Viewfinder
items.description: A transparent camera-viewfinder overlay for footage: a blinking REC dot, corner brackets, a running timecode, a battery and mode readout, an exposure line, and a focus box that hunts and snaps onto a point. The background is clear by default, so a host lays it over a clip; set the background colour and turn Transparent off to preview it alone.

items.name: hw-frame
items.title: Sketched Photo Frame
items.description: A hand-drawn wobbly border draws itself around a photo panel with corner sparks and a handwritten caption; the whole unit tilts and boils like stop-motion.

items.name: hw-path-text
items.title: Handwriting Along a Path
items.description: Handwriting flows along any SVG path, one letter at a time, over a faint dotted guide.

items.name: hw-pipeline
items.title: Hand-Drawn Flowchart
items.description: Wobbled boxes with handwritten labels joined by curved connectors, drawing on in sequence from a list of steps.

items.name: hw-text-cloud
items.title: Hand-Drawn Speech Bubble
items.description: A wobbly hand-drawn speech bubble: the outline draws on, the paper fill fades in and handwritten text types per character.

items.name: hw-title
items.title: Handwritten Title
items.description: Handwritten display text with a word-by-word highlight sweep, a seeded squiggle underline that matches the text width, and a hand-drawn boil.

items.name: hw-write-title
items.title: Handwritten Write-On Title
items.description: Letters are written on by a pen that follows each glyph's real stroke order, slowing into curves and lifting between strokes, then a squiggle underline draws itself.

items.name: hyperspace
items.title: Hyperspace
items.description: A jump to lightspeed: stars stretch into streaks around the outgoing scene, which is pushed toward the camera, then a white flash cuts to the incoming scene while the last streaks fade. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .hsp-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: impact-shake
items.title: Impact Shake
items.description: Heavy content slams down from above with a squash, a damped camera jolt, a two-frame RGB split and dust puffs kicking out sideways. The built-in subject is a big word; a host puts its own content in by replacing the .is-word elements.

items.name: indonesia-map
items.title: Indonesia Map
items.description: Peta Indonesia per provinsi: provinsi muncul dari tengah, lalu singkatan, dan provinsi pilihan menyala bergantian. Di bingkai vertikal peta dibagi dua baris, barat dan timur.

items.name: infinite-bento-pan
items.title: Infinite Bento Pan
items.description: A hypnotic diagonal camera glide over an oversized grid of bento cards (charts, counters, code, gradients) with a vignette. All figures are filler.

items.name: infinite-marquee
items.title: Infinite Marquee
items.description: A continuously scrolling horizontal text strip that loops seamlessly.

items.name: infinite-zoom-words
items.title: Infinite Zoom Words
items.description: The camera zooms through nested frames. Each frame holds one word of a phrase and a smaller frame with the next word inside it; the zoom steps in word by word and ends on the last frame, which holds the final word and a lockup line. Words and lockup come from variables.

items.name: inflate
items.title: Inflate
items.description: A flat sliver puffs up like a balloon toy, squashes and settles into a glossy mark, then the wordmark slides out. The mark is a fixed rounded square with a dot; the wordmark is the text variable.

items.name: ink-arrow
items.title: Ink Arrow
items.description: A hand-drawn arrow that draws itself from one point to another in stop-motion poses.

items.name: ink-underline
items.title: Ink Underline
items.description: A hand-dragged ink stroke that draws itself across in a few stop-motion poses.

items.name: inline-highlight
items.title: Inline Highlight
items.description: A sentence where one word is picked out by fading from the base colour to an accent colour.

items.name: inline-pill-takeover
items.title: Inline Pill Takeover
items.description: A clipped pill expands inside a sentence, pushes the words apart, and takes over the frame.

items.name: inline-word-roll
items.title: Inline Word Roll
items.description: Switch words beside a fixed prefix with an accelerating vertical roll; the whole line recenters as word lengths change.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A text field that plays its states: a pointer hovers and clicks it, it focuses with a ring, the value types in, then the field shows an invalid state.

items.name: iris-wipe
items.title: Iris Wipe
items.description: A classic iris: the outgoing scene closes to a small dot on a solid color, then the incoming scene opens from the same point. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .irw-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: isometric-build
items.title: Isometric Build
items.description: An isometric tile grid springs up row by row into a stepped block sculpture with one accent tower, then holds.

items.name: jitter-text
items.title: Jitter Text
items.description: A line of text trembles in tiny steps of position and tilt, settles, rests, then trembles back.

items.name: jumping-text
items.title: Jumping Text
items.description: Words (or letters) hop in from below, tilted, and spring upright one after another with a little overshoot.

items.name: keystroke
items.title: Keystroke
items.description: Physical keycaps rise and press to show keyboard shortcuts, one chord after another.

items.name: kinetic-center-build
items.title: Kinetic Center Build
items.description: Words enter from the right one at a time and push the line left so the sentence builds around the centre.

items.name: kinetic-morph-text
items.title: Kinetic Morph Text
items.description: Letters lift, rotate, and reshape into the next phrase with delicate outline trails.

items.name: kinetic-text
items.title: Kinetic Text
items.description: A thin variable-weight word where a pointer sweeps over the letters: the letter under it swells to black weight with an outline, and its neighbours follow at lesser weights.

items.name: kinetic-warp
items.title: Kinetic Warp
items.description: A coarse mesh warp bends a whole word in staccato beats, one axis moving per keyframe.

items.name: launch-anything
items.title: Product Showcase
items.description: A 26.7-second editorial product film in cream and forest green: chrome-like words open onto a dusk horizon, a button becomes a portal into a desk, a laptop camera move steps through seven product screens, a symbol field, architectural linework, two launch plates, a typed address and a frame-shaped mark. Silent: sound is added by the host. Photographs are drawn with SVG by default (the chrome type is a 2D approximation of the shader); pass image paths to use real photos.

items.name: lens-zoom
items.title: Lens Zoom
items.description: A fast fisheye lens push: the outgoing scene bulges and zooms into the lens with motion blur, a camera shake and a slight color fringe, then the incoming scene unwinds out of the same lens. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .lz-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: letter-3d-swap
items.title: Letter 3D Swap
items.description: Every letter is a two-faced block that rolls a quarter turn in 3D, from the top, bottom, left or right, in a staggered wave that repeats.

items.name: letter-swap-forward
items.title: Letter Swap Forward
items.description: Each letter slides out and an identical copy rolls in from the other side, in a staggered wave that repeats forward.

items.name: letter-swap-pingpong
items.title: Letter Swap Ping-Pong
items.description: Each letter slides out and an identical copy rolls in, then after a hold the wave runs back the way it came (ping-pong).

items.name: life-grid
items.title: Life Grid
items.description: Conway's Game of Life runs on a seeded grid, newborn cells flashing in the accent and dying cells shrinking away.

items.name: light-leak
items.title: Light Leak
items.description: A warm analog light leak drifts across the frame, blows out at the cut and cools off on the next scene.

items.name: line-boil
items.title: Line Boil
items.description: A hand-drawn outline draws itself, boils on threes like a cel animation, and fills with color while it keeps boiling. Takes any closed outline as SVG path data in the path variable (default: a five-point star).

items.name: line-by-line-slide
items.title: Line by Line Slide
items.description: Lines of text slide in from the left one after another, then slide out to the right in turn.

items.name: line-shadow-text
items.title: Line Shadow Text
items.description: A bold headline with a hatched drop shadow: fine diagonal lines fill the shadow and slide slowly through it.

items.name: liquid-edge-wipe
items.title: Liquid Edge Wipe
items.description: Three layered colour panels flood up the frame with wobbly liquid edges, each point on the edge with its own random delay, then peel away upward to reveal the next scene.

items.name: liquid-fill
items.title: Liquid Fill
items.description: A drop falls into an outlined mark and liquid rises with a sloshing surface and bubbles until the mark is solid. Give it any closed shape as the shape path variable.

items.name: liquid-text-morph
items.title: Liquid Text Morph
items.description: Melts one word into the next through a gooey blur-and-threshold filter: letters arrive squat and wide and tighten as the words trade places.

items.name: live-code-compilation
items.title: Live Code Compilation
items.description: Split screen: code is typed on the left and the button on the right snaps to match on the exact frame each property finishes. On a tall frame the split stacks (code on top, preview below).

items.name: logo-enter
items.title: Logo Enter
items.description: A stacked, overlapping group of round chips that spring in one by one, then hold. Ships with generic placeholder marks; set the chip count and colours to match your own.

items.name: long-shadow
items.title: Long Shadow
items.description: A flat icon pops in and casts a long shadow to the frame edge, then the light swings and the shadow sweeps around on a spring. A built-in check badge stands in for the mark; a host replaces the contents of the .ls-mark layers with its own flat icon.

items.name: loyalty-stamp-card
items.title: Loyalty Stamp Card
items.description: A shop's stamp card with 8 to 10 slots: stamps press in one by one, a counter ticks up, and the last slot opens to the reward ("GRATIS 1"). The slot count, how many are filled and the reward text are variables.

items.name: marker-highlight
items.title: Marker Highlight
items.description: A highlighter-pen bar springs across one word of a sentence, like a marker stroke.

items.name: mask-reveal-up
items.title: Mask Reveal Up
items.description: Lines reveal upward with a soft masked feel and compact stagger.

items.name: mask-text
items.title: Mask Text
items.description: A round spotlight follows an invisible pointer across one line of text and reveals a different line inside it; it swells from a dot to a wide disc and shrinks again.

items.name: matrix-decode
items.title: Matrix Decode
items.description: Scrambled symbols resolve into the real text one character at a time, left to right, in a monospace face.

items.name: media-between-text
items.title: Media Between Text
items.description: A sentence with a gap in the middle: a rounded media tile springs open between the two halves, pushing the words apart, then closes again. The tile is a drawn gradient by default, or your own image.

items.name: menu-price-board
items.title: Menu Price Board
items.description: A clean menu board: the title rises through a mask, then each item slides in with its dotted leader and its price, a short note appears and the shop details rise at the bottom. White page, black type, one accent on the note and the order button. Items come from one variable, one per line as "Name|Price".

items.name: message-bubble
items.title: Message Bubble
items.description: A speech bubble that pops in, with an optional reaction badge that springs onto its corner.

items.name: messenger-chat-flow
items.title: Messenger Chat Flow
items.description: A scripted messaging conversation with delivery details: timestamps and read ticks or a delivered receipt, a typing status in the header, a send button that morphs from mic to send, typing dots and reactions that pop onto bubbles.

items.name: metis-text
items.title: Metis Line Underline
items.description: A thin line draws under a word from the left, then leaves to the right; it repeats like a hover on a link.

items.name: micro-scale-fade
items.title: Micro Scale Fade
items.description: A calm, tiny scale pop for subtle premium polish on labels and headings.

items.name: milestone-counter-list
items.title: Milestone Counter List
items.description: A follower or fan milestone: a rolling odometer counts up to a total while a list of named entries flies past and settles on the last one, with an accent star and underline.

items.name: mirror-text
items.title: Mirror Text
items.description: A word stacked from four clipped copies; the copies slide in a staggered ripple, as if the text were sliced into mirrored strips.

items.name: mondrian-split
items.title: Mondrian Split
items.description: A De Stijl grid draws itself line by line, fills with primary colors, and one cell expands to take over the frame.

items.name: money-count-burst
items.title: Money Count Burst
items.description: A big amount counts from zero up to a target, turns green with a flash, and bursts into bills and coins.

items.name: moving-pen
items.title: Moving Pen
items.description: A glowing pen-tip dot glides across the frame on a curve, drawing a luminous trail while a handwritten line fades in beneath its passing.

items.name: multi-direction-slide-text
items.title: Multi Direction Slide Text
items.description: Two lines of text arrive from opposite sides at once: the first slides in from the left, the second from the right, both fading up and meeting in the centre stack.

items.name: music-player-card
items.title: Music Player Card
items.description: A frosted-glass now-playing card with a big gradient cover, track and artist name; it rises in, the text staggers up, the cover breathes, and it leaves.

items.name: nebula
items.title: Nebula Orb
items.description: A small world of pink and blue gas swirls inside a sphere on black.

items.name: neon-flicker-text
items.title: Neon Flicker Text
items.description: Lights a word tube by tube like a neon sign, with a mains hum that never quite settles and a dying flicker on the way out.

items.name: neon-sign
items.title: Neon Sign
items.description: A glass neon tube stutters alive segment by segment, buzzes off once, then holds lit with a glow on the wall. Replace the path variable with your own monoline SVG path.

items.name: nested-arch-stroke-loop
items.title: Nested Arch Stroke Loop
items.description: Five nested arch strokes each draw in as a short capsule, run to the end of the line and re-colour, every one on its own eased curve, so the colours ripple through the arches.

items.name: notes-reveal
items.title: Notes Reveal
items.description: A personal note is typed character by character with a caret, the page scrolling up as each line lands, then it cuts to a paper card with a marker headline and a ticked checklist.

items.name: notification-flood-lockscreen
items.title: Notification Flood Lock Screen
items.description: A phone lock screen fills with a stack of escalating message notifications, then a last one answers the flood.

items.name: notification-stack
items.title: Notification Stack
items.description: Four notification banners land one after another and restack upward over a warm backdrop, then a dark end card with a two-line headline fades in.

items.name: number-wheel
items.title: Number Wheel
items.description: A mechanical odometer: each digit is a wheel that rolls to the next number as a count runs up.

items.name: offset-shadow-lower-third
items.title: Offset Shadow Lower Third
items.description: A bold news-style lower third: a white headline bar with a colored offset shadow over a colored sub-line with a white one. It holds still.

items.name: onboarding-stepper-flow
items.title: Onboarding Stepper Flow
items.description: A multi-step onboarding scene: a stepper advances across three panels (an input, a radio, a switch) while the Next button presses, and the last press runs the Finish button to success.

items.name: open-sign-flip
items.title: Open Sign Flip
items.description: A shop sign hangs from two cords and swings in, then flips from "TUTUP" to "BUKA" and settles with a little sway. The opening hours slide up below it. Shop, both words and the hours are variables.

items.name: orbit-lock
items.title: Orbit Lock
items.description: Moons ride tilted, shrinking orbits into a core that bursts into a ring flash, and the logo springs into place. The placeholder lockup is a stand-in: a host swaps in its own logo by editing the .ol-logo element.

items.name: order-tracker
items.title: Order Tracker
items.description: A four-step order progress line (Pesanan diterima, Dikemas, Dikirim, Sampai): a dot travels along the line, each step checks off as it passes, and the current step's label grows. Vertical in portrait, horizontal in landscape. The steps and the current step are variables.

items.name: outline-fill-track-text
items.title: Outline Fill Track Text
items.description: A rising lead word gives way to an outlined value that fills as one continuous track moves left.

items.name: outline-trace
items.title: Outline Trace
items.description: Every glyph contour draws itself as a stroke, letter by letter, then the fill wipes up inside each letter and the stroke fades into it.

items.name: page-turn
items.title: Page Turn
items.description: The outgoing scene lifts off like a page and rotates up out of the frame in a few stepped poses, uncovering the next scene. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .pgt-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: paper-plane-route-draw
items.title: Paper Plane Route Draw
items.description: A paper plane swells from small to large as it flies along a looping curved route with its nose following the line, while the route draws in behind it and then thins out, and the whole scene fades away.

items.name: paper-sticker
items.title: Paper Sticker
items.description: Taped paper chips that slap onto a stop-motion scene over two poses, one after another.

items.name: paper-tear
items.title: Paper Tear
items.description: The outgoing scene is printed on paper that strains, rips down the middle with a jolt of the camera and a flash, and is flung apart in two torn halves with flying scraps, revealing the next scene. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .ptr-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: paper-wobble
items.title: Paper Wobble
items.description: Per-pose reshoot jitter that makes any content feel hand-placed on a desk.

items.name: parallax-depth
items.title: Parallax Depth
items.description: A layered landscape trucks sideways with a gentle push-in, near layers sliding faster than far ones. Built-in sun and hills preview on their own; a host adds its own full-frame layers by pushing an element and a depth (1 is nearest, larger moves less) onto LAYERS in the script.

items.name: particle-dissolve
items.title: Particle Dissolve
items.description: The frame breaks into drifting grey dust, bright parts throwing theirs furthest, with specks that twinkle and a little colour fringing; the next scene coalesces back out of the dust. Runs its WebGL shader over two built-in panels (a stat and a bar chart, then a render queue; text and colours from variables), not over the host's scenes: 60 frames of the first panel, a 36-frame transition, then the second panel. To use it between your own scenes, copy the shader into your composition and feed it your two frames as textures.

items.name: path-distribute-shapes
items.title: Path Distribute Shapes
items.description: Hand-drawn letter outlines draw on, small squares pop onto every line, then slide along their paths so each lands at its own distributed point, shift colour and size in waves, round into dots, flatten into bars, converge on the centre as a line, and a headline rises from beneath it.

items.name: path-ride
items.title: Path Ride
items.description: A line draws itself along a curve with the text riding behind its head, then the curve pulls taut and the text settles on a straight, centered baseline.

items.name: payment-methods-row
items.title: Payment Methods Row
items.description: A line ("Bayar pakai apa saja") and a row of generic payment chips (Transfer bank, Kode QR, E-wallet, COD, Kartu) that pop in one after another, each with a small drawn glyph. No brand names or logos. The line and the methods are variables.

items.name: pendulum-wave
items.title: Pendulum Wave
items.description: A row of pendulums drifts out of phase into waves, then snaps back into a straight line.

items.name: per-character-rise
items.title: Per Character Rise
items.description: Letters slide up from below with no blur, one after another: crisp and kinetic.

items.name: per-word-crossfade
items.title: Per Word Crossfade
items.description: A sentence dissolves word by word into a new one, each word rising slightly as it arrives.

items.name: period-drop
items.title: Period Drop
items.description: A word rises out of its line, then a colored dot falls from above the frame, bounces with squash and stretch, and settles as the period.

items.name: perlin-dissolve
items.title: Perlin Dissolve
items.description: Organic noise grows over the outgoing scene until the frame is flooded with one color, then the incoming scene fades in. Rebuilt with a deterministic Canvas 2D noise field instead of the original WebGL shader. The block draws its own colored field between two built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .prd-panel elements); to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: perspective-marquee
items.title: Perspective Marquee
items.description: A row of words scrolls sideways on a 3D tilt, fading and blurring toward the edges.

items.name: perspective-squeeze
items.title: Perspective Squeeze
items.description: Two lines of heavy type endlessly trade height while corner-pinned perspective bends the flat stack into receding planes.

items.name: photo-frame-draw-reveal
items.title: Photo Frame Draw Reveal
items.description: A photo opens from the centre with a circular clip, then a thin circle, a square outline and a notched decorative border draw themselves around it. Without an image it shows a drawn placeholder scene.

items.name: phyllotaxis
items.title: Phyllotaxis
items.description: Seeds spiral out at the golden angle into a sunflower head, then one Fibonacci arm turns accent and pulses outward while the head slowly turns.

items.name: pie-slice-sweep
items.title: Pie Slice Sweep
items.description: Pie slices start as one wedge at the top and sweep out to their own start and end angles while their radius shrinks, on a power3 in-out ease, then each slice gets its percentage and a legend appears below.

items.name: pixel-heading-character
items.title: Pixel Heading Character
items.description: A heading whose letters each take a pixel typeface of their own and keep changing on a staggered clock: all five faces mixed, a travelling wave, pseudo-random picks, or one face for the whole line.

items.name: pixel-heading-word
items.title: Pixel Heading Word
items.description: A heading set in a pixel typeface that changes face as a pointer rests on it: either cycling through five pixel styles every few hundred milliseconds, or swapping once to a hover style, with the style name in a small label.

items.name: pixel-sort
items.title: Pixel Sort
items.description: The outgoing scene melts downward in vertical columns of different speeds, smeared into bright streaks, and the incoming scene drops in column by column and snaps sharp. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .pxs-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: pixelate-region
items.title: Pixelate Region
items.description: Covers chosen rectangles of a scene with an opaque mosaic and leaves the rest perfectly sharp, the way a demo hides keys, tokens and addresses. Runs its WebGL shader over its own built-in scene (a credentials page; title, rows and note from variables, with the values of the chosen rows covered), not over the host video.

items.name: pixelate-text
items.title: Pixelate Text
items.description: A title block, a paragraph and a gradient swatch start as coarse blocks of pixels and resolve to sharp, using an SVG pixelate filter (convolve, tile, dilate) whose block size eases down to one pixel.

items.name: plastic
items.title: Plastic Orb
items.description: A glossy white plastic orb with soft studio reflections, on black.

items.name: plucked-text
items.title: Plucked Text
items.description: Text rides on a taut string: it is pulled, let go and rings (high notes first, a slow sway last), carrying and tilting every letter.

items.name: polaroid
items.title: Polaroid
items.description: An instant-photo frame with a handwritten caption. The photo is a built-in live placeholder (a drifting sunrise gradient); layer your own video or image over the photo window to use it.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A hover card that opens above a mention chip as the cursor arrives, then closes when it leaves.

items.name: price-drop
items.title: Price Drop
items.description: A product name rises through a mask, the old price is struck through, the new price counts up to its value in one accent colour and a quiet saving label (like "Hemat 28%") appears under it, on a clean white page.

items.name: product-callouts
items.title: Product Callouts
items.description: A product in the centre with three or four thin leader lines drawing out from points on it to labels with short spec text, one after another, in a spec-sheet style. The product is a drawn tumbler or your own image; labels, specs and the points the lines start from come from one variable.

items.name: product-grid-reveal
items.title: Product Grid Reveal
items.description: A mosaic of 6 or 9 product tiles, each with a name and a price, flips in with a stagger. One tile then scales up as the highlight and gets a Terlaris badge while the rest dim. Tiles show a drawn placeholder or your own images.

items.name: profile-follow-card
items.title: Profile Follow Card
items.description: A creator profile card springs in, its parts blur in one after another, then a cursor glides to the button and clicks it, flipping Follow to Following.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A progress bar that fills along a scripted value: a fast start, a stall, then a finish.

items.name: push-through
items.title: Push Through
items.description: The outgoing scene is pushed toward the camera and blurs away while the next scene arrives from behind it. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .pth-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: puzzle-snap
items.title: Puzzle Snap
items.description: Geometric pieces spin in from scattered positions and snap into a mark with sparks, then the wordmark slides out beside it. The mark is a fixed set of shapes; the wordmark is the text variable.

items.name: qr-pay-scan
items.title: QR Pay Scan
items.description: A generic QR card (a drawn pattern from a seeded generator, not a real code) is swept by a scan line, then a success check appears with the amount and "Pembayaran berhasil". Shop, amount, texts and the pattern seed are variables.

items.name: rack-focus
items.title: Rack Focus
items.description: A focus pull with real aperture bokeh: a night scene of lights spread from 1.2 m to 80 m, where the focal plane travels from the string of bulbs in front of the lens to the lit towers behind it, and every light is an image of the lens aperture sized by its circle of confusion. WebGL point sprites.

items.name: radial-burst
items.title: Radial Burst
items.description: A dot launches rounded ribbons that curl into a ring, spin shut and sweep out of frame in a bold geometric burst.

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio
items.description: A radio that a pointer selects: the ring takes the primary color and the dot scales in.

items.name: random-letter-swap-forward
items.title: Random Letter Swap Forward
items.description: Letters swap out in a random order, each sliding out as an identical copy rolls in, and the wave repeats forward.

items.name: random-letter-swap-pingpong
items.title: Random Letter Swap Ping-Pong
items.description: Letters swap out in a random order and, after a hold, swap back in another random-feeling wave (ping-pong).

items.name: rating-summary
items.title: Rating Summary
items.description: A big average rating ("4,9" with an Indonesian decimal comma) counts up while five stars fill, five bars (5 to 1 stars) grow to their shares, and the review count ("1.284 ulasan") counts up last. Score, shares and review count are variables.

items.name: receipt-print
items.title: Receipt Print
items.description: A shop receipt prints out line by line from a printer slot (shop name, items with quantity and price, a dashed rule, the total) and a LUNAS stamp thunks onto it. Items, prices, shop name and total are variables.

items.name: reel
items.title: Reel
