items.description: A fixed centered card where images stack on the z-axis and each blooms open over the last. Five CSS-drawn placeholder screens stand in for your shots: a host swaps its own images in by replacing the contents of each .rl-shot with an img (object-fit cover).

items.name: release-teaser
items.title: Release Teaser
items.description: A sixteen-second release announcement: five short statements resolve from the center outward over an extreme close-up of a dark, beveled open ring, then the camera pulls back to the ring behind the release lockup and the light recedes while the name holds. Silent: sound is added by the host.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: A two-panel split whose divider is grabbed by the cursor and dragged right, left, then back to the middle.

items.name: review-card-stack
items.title: Review Card Stack
items.description: Three short customer review cards (name, stars, a one-line quote) arrive as a stack, then shuffle: the front card swings out and goes to the back so each review comes to the front in turn. Reviews are a variable.

items.name: rgb-glitch-text
items.title: RGB Glitch Text
items.description: A short burst where red, green and blue copies of the text jitter apart, then snap back.

items.name: ridged-burn
items.title: Ridged Burn
items.description: abs(noise) creates sharp lightning-crack edges. Blackbody color gradient with high-frequency ember sparks. Plays between two built-in panels (A and B) that a host swaps for its own scenes: copy the fragment shader into your composition and feed it your two frames as textures.

items.name: ring-text
items.title: Ring Text
items.description: Text runs around a tilted 3D band that spins, reading on the near side and mirrored on the far side.

items.name: ripple-waves
items.title: Ripple Waves
items.description: Exponential sine waves with sharp crests and broad troughs. Both scenes ripple in opposite phases. Plays between two built-in panels (A and B) that a host swaps for its own scenes: copy the fragment shader into your composition and feed it your two frames as textures.

items.name: ripple-zoom
items.title: Ripple Zoom
items.description: Rings of color ripple out and zoom past the camera while the outgoing scene swells away and the incoming scene scales up out of the pattern. Rebuilt with a deterministic Canvas 2D gradient instead of the original WebGL shader. The block draws its own colored field between two built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .rpz-panel elements); to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: riso-print
items.title: Riso Print
items.description: Print a subject in two risograph inks, with the accent plate sliding in off-register and settling a hair out of alignment over grainy paper. A built-in geometric poster stands in for the subject; a host replaces the contents of both .rp-subject layers with its own picture.

items.name: roll-text
items.title: Roll Text
items.description: Each letter sits in a one-line window and rolls up to an identical copy, one after another, so the word seems to turn over like a split-flap or a barrel; it replays like a re-hover.

items.name: rolling-number
items.title: Rolling Number
items.description: Odometer where every place rolls at its own speed, new places rising into view, settling exactly on the target value.

items.name: rolodex-flip
items.title: Rolodex Flip
items.description: Cycle a word through a list of values inside a held line, with a 3D rolodex card flip.

items.name: rotate-in
items.title: Rotate In
items.description: Text swings into place: spinning in plane (z) or hinged in depth on the x or y axis, with a small scale-up and a fade that leads the move.

items.name: rush-type
items.title: Rush Type
items.description: White words blast into vertical RGB shutter trails, one forceful word at a time: the word falls out of perspective, stretches into a tall red/green/blue-fringed smear, snaps to a sharp readable rest, then blasts away as the next word arrives. The fringing comes from motion alone, not from tinting the text; a tube mask and glow ride along with the blast. WebGL, over an opaque background colour.

items.name: scale-down-fade
items.title: Scale Down Fade
items.description: Subtle premium settle-in with a restrained scale-down fade on exit.

items.name: scale-letter-text
items.title: Scale Letter Text
items.description: A pointer hops across the word letter by letter: the hovered letter swells, lifts toward the viewer and tilts back, its neighbours follow at half strength, all with a springy overshoot.

items.name: scissors-paper-cut
items.title: Scissors Paper Cut
items.description: A pair of scissors snips along a looping figure-eight path, cutting a paper triangle in two; the halves fly apart, blur out, and sprinkle confetti dots that fall under gravity, over and over.

items.name: scramble-in
items.title: Scramble In
items.description: Text types itself in left to right with a short run of random glyphs ahead of the cursor that resolve into the real letters; several lines can start in a quick cascade.

items.name: scribble-circle
items.title: Scribble Circle
items.description: A hand-drawn marker circle scribbles itself around a target in stop-motion poses.

items.name: scroll-menu-phone
items.title: Scroll Menu Phone
items.description: A generic phone frame with a menu list. The list scrolls with momentum, a touch dot taps an item, and the item expands to show its price and a Tambah button, which the dot then taps and a cart count appears. Names, descriptions and prices come from one variable.

items.name: sdf-iris
items.title: SDF Iris
items.description: Aspect-corrected circle SDF opening from center. Triple onion ring glow with warm exponential falloff. Plays between two built-in panels (A and B) that a host swaps for its own scenes: copy the fragment shader into your composition and feed it your two frames as textures.

items.name: search-reveal
items.title: Search Reveal
items.description: Construction circles expand into a search field, type your product name, and reveal an abstract graphic panel.

items.name: security-cam
items.title: Security Cam
items.description: A scene as surveillance footage: luma and colour squeezed into blocks, colour drained, blacks crushed and a slow brightness pump with noise crawling in the shadows. Runs its WebGL shader over its own built-in scene (a render queue list; title, rows and background from variables), not over the host video.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A select box: a pointer clicks the trigger, the option panel drops open, an option is hovered, pressed and committed with a check, then the panel closes.

items.name: select-item
items.title: Select Item
items.description: A selectable option row: a pointer hovers it, presses it, and it commits as selected with a check, inside a small option list.

items.name: select-menu
items.title: Select Menu
items.description: A vertical option list: a highlight glides down to an option as the pointer follows it, presses it and commits it with a check, then fades back.

items.name: selection-snap
items.title: Selection Snap
items.description: A thin word in a loose viewfinder snaps into a design-tool selection while it goes from Thin to Black, pops its handles and counts up a size badge.

items.name: separate-away-text
items.title: Separate Away Text
items.description: Two stacked lines fade in together while drifting slightly apart, the top one up and the bottom one down, opening a small gap between them.

items.name: settings-toggle-flow
items.title: Settings Toggle Flow
items.description: A two-column settings card: it blurs in, then a cursor flips the notifications switch, opens the theme select and picks an option, drags the volume slider, and clicks Save, ending on a confirmation toast.

items.name: shader-caustics
items.title: Caustics
items.description: A web of refracted-light filaments, denser toward the bottom of the frame, drifts over a near-black floor, drawn in WebGL. An accent color can tint the filaments.

items.name: shader-color-panels
items.title: Shader Color Panels
items.description: Translucent color panels swing through depth and slide past each other: a glassy, architectural WebGL backdrop in any palette.

items.name: shader-dithering
items.title: Shader Dithering
items.description: An animated gradient field rendered as a two-color ordered dither, like 1-bit print or an old screen: a lo-fi WebGL backdrop.

items.name: shader-dot-orbit
items.title: Shader Dot Orbit
items.description: A loose grid of colored dots, each orbiting inside its own cell: a structured, network-like WebGL backdrop.

items.name: shader-gem-smoke
items.title: Gem Smoke
items.description: Smoke in your palette flows behind and inside a glassy silhouette: a built-in shape such as a diamond, or a bold glyph or logo letter you type. Drawn in WebGL.

items.name: shader-god-rays
items.title: God Rays
items.description: Volumetric light rays fan out from a source just above the frame: soft, slowly moving shafts of light in your palette, drawn in WebGL.

items.name: shader-grain-gradient
items.title: Shader Grain Gradient
items.description: A grainy multi-stop gradient shape drifts slowly under film-grain texture: an analog, premium WebGL backdrop in any palette and one of seven shapes.

items.name: shader-grain-gradient-arcade
items.title: Shader Grain Gradient Arcade
items.description: Retro grainy dots in orange, yellow and green on black. A WebGL shader backdrop; the arcade preset of shader-grain-gradient.

items.name: shader-grain-gradient-blush
items.title: Shader Grain Gradient Blush
items.description: Pastel pink and apricot blob morphing on warm off-white. A WebGL shader backdrop; the blush preset of shader-grain-gradient.

items.name: shader-grain-gradient-dune
items.title: Shader Grain Gradient Dune
items.description: Sandy grain wave in tan, caramel and rust. A WebGL shader backdrop; the dune preset of shader-grain-gradient.

items.name: shader-grain-gradient-horizon
items.title: Shader Grain Gradient Horizon
items.description: Peach horizon band rolling between navy and pale sky. A WebGL shader backdrop; the horizon preset of shader-grain-gradient.

items.name: shader-grain-gradient-nebula
items.title: Shader Grain Gradient Nebula
items.description: Magenta and cyan glow blooming from the corners of deep space. A WebGL shader backdrop; the nebula preset of shader-grain-gradient.

items.name: shader-grain-gradient-orb
items.title: Shader Grain Gradient Orb
items.description: Large grainy sphere in periwinkle, violet and pink. A WebGL shader backdrop; the orb preset of shader-grain-gradient.

items.name: shader-grain-gradient-sunrise
items.title: Shader Grain Gradient Sunrise
items.description: Grainy wave of coral and gold rising over a plum night. A WebGL shader backdrop; the sunrise preset of shader-grain-gradient.

items.name: shader-grain-gradient-tide
items.title: Shader Grain Gradient Tide
items.description: Teal ripple ring pulsing out of a dark sea-green core. A WebGL shader backdrop; the tide preset of shader-grain-gradient.

items.name: shader-grain-gradient-ultraviolet
items.title: Shader Grain Gradient Ultraviolet
items.description: Electric magenta and blue blob morphing on ultraviolet black. A WebGL shader backdrop; the ultraviolet preset of shader-grain-gradient.

items.name: shader-light-tunnel
items.title: Light Tunnel
items.description: A forward flight through a tunnel of luminous, twisting light ribbons with a halftone texture and a soft defocused vanishing point, drawn in WebGL.

items.name: shader-liquid-metal
items.title: Liquid Metal
items.description: A molten metal surface with flowing, chromatic highlights fills the frame, drawn in WebGL. Pick a shape to make it an emblem instead.

items.name: shader-mesh-gradient
items.title: Shader Mesh Gradient
items.description: Soft color blobs drift and blend across the whole frame: a calm, looping WebGL backdrop in any palette.

items.name: shader-mesh-gradient-aurora
items.title: Shader Mesh Gradient Aurora
items.description: Cyan and violet ribbons swirling out of a near-black sky. A WebGL shader backdrop; the aurora preset of shader-mesh-gradient.

items.name: shader-mesh-gradient-dusk
items.title: Shader Mesh Gradient Dusk
items.description: Violet dusk with coral and peach light drifting through deep indigo. A WebGL shader backdrop; the dusk preset of shader-mesh-gradient.

items.name: shader-mesh-gradient-ember
items.title: Shader Mesh Gradient Ember
items.description: Molten orange and amber pooling in dark oxblood. A WebGL shader backdrop; the ember preset of shader-mesh-gradient.

items.name: shader-mesh-gradient-ink
items.title: Shader Mesh Gradient Ink
items.description: Monochrome ink folds in charcoal and silver with grain. A WebGL shader backdrop; the ink preset of shader-mesh-gradient.

items.name: shader-mesh-gradient-lagoon
items.title: Shader Mesh Gradient Lagoon
items.description: Bright aqua and teal shallows with a deep-blue undertow. A WebGL shader backdrop; the lagoon preset of shader-mesh-gradient.

items.name: shader-mesh-gradient-lavender
items.title: Shader Mesh Gradient Lavender
items.description: Soft lilac and pink haze with grain-softened edges. A WebGL shader backdrop; the lavender preset of shader-mesh-gradient.

items.name: shader-mesh-gradient-mint
items.title: Shader Mesh Gradient Mint
items.description: Airy mint and sky-blue pastel wash around a deeper green core. A WebGL shader backdrop; the mint preset of shader-mesh-gradient.

items.name: shader-mesh-gradient-peach
items.title: Shader Mesh Gradient Peach
items.description: Warm peach and cream glow with a whisper of film grain. A WebGL shader backdrop; the peach preset of shader-mesh-gradient.

items.name: shader-mesh-gradient-synthwave
items.title: Shader Mesh Gradient Synthwave
items.description: Night-purple field lit by a warm coral sunset glow. A WebGL shader backdrop; the synthwave preset of shader-mesh-gradient.

items.name: shader-metaballs
items.title: Metaballs
items.description: Soft blobs drift, merge and split like a lava lamp, each tinted from your palette, drawn in WebGL.

items.name: shader-neuro-noise
items.title: Neuro Noise
items.description: A web of glowing filaments that slowly morphs, in three colors over a dark field, drawn in WebGL.

items.name: shader-perlin-noise
items.title: Perlin Noise
items.description: Soft Perlin-noise clouds drift across the frame as a duotone fog, drawn in WebGL.

items.name: shader-pulsing-border
items.title: Pulsing Border
items.description: A glowing, pulsing frame of light runs around the edges of the frame and leaves the center clear for content, drawn in WebGL.

items.name: shader-seam
items.title: Seam
items.description: A transition between two panels: a colored silk-and-halftone material appears across the frame, the scene underneath swaps while it is opaque, then it dissolves in place to uncover the next. The block plays it between its own panels A and B, with text from variables; WebGL.

items.name: shader-simplex-noise
items.title: Simplex Noise
items.description: A smooth simplex-noise flow field drifts through your palette in soft bands, drawn in WebGL.

items.name: shader-smoke-ring
items.title: Smoke Ring
items.description: A single soft ring of smoke curls and dissipates in the center of a dark field, drawn in WebGL.

items.name: shader-spiral
items.title: Spiral
items.description: Two-tone spiral arms rotate out from the center of the frame, drawn in WebGL.

items.name: shader-spiral-pass
items.title: Shader Spiral Pass
items.description: A neon spiral tunnel swallows the outgoing scene, the camera dives through its center, and an expanding aperture reveals the incoming scene. Rebuilt with a deterministic Canvas 2D tunnel instead of the original WebGL shader. The block draws its own colored field between two built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .ssp-panel elements); to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: shader-strata
items.title: Strata
items.description: Fine horizontal layers of sediment, their edges bent by noise, drift at their own depths so the stack reads as a living foundation. Drawn in WebGL; an accent color can tint the deep layers.

items.name: shader-swirl
items.title: Shader Swirl
items.description: Concentric bands swirling around a center point. A WebGL shader backdrop.

items.name: shader-swirl-candy
items.title: Shader Swirl Candy
items.description: Pastel pink, lilac and sky-blue spiral, soft and sweet. A WebGL shader backdrop; the candy preset of shader-swirl.

items.name: shader-swirl-citrus
items.title: Shader Swirl Citrus
items.description: Juicy yellow, pink and green bands spiralling on cream. A WebGL shader backdrop; the citrus preset of shader-swirl.

items.name: shader-swirl-ember
items.title: Shader Swirl Ember
items.description: Gold and orange fire bands spinning around a dark core. A WebGL shader backdrop; the ember preset of shader-swirl.

items.name: shader-swirl-hypno
items.title: Shader Swirl Hypno
items.description: High-contrast black and white hypnotic spiral. A WebGL shader backdrop; the hypno preset of shader-swirl.

items.name: shader-swirl-lilac
items.title: Shader Swirl Lilac
items.description: Dreamy lilac and baby-blue swirl around a dark eye. A WebGL shader backdrop; the lilac preset of shader-swirl.

items.name: shader-swirl-neon
items.title: Shader Swirl Neon
items.description: Neon teal, purple and pink vortex around a dark core. A WebGL shader backdrop; the neon preset of shader-swirl.

items.name: shader-swirl-retro
items.title: Shader Swirl Retro
items.description: Seventies spiral in orange, sand and teal. A WebGL shader backdrop; the retro preset of shader-swirl.

items.name: shader-swirl-sunburst
items.title: Shader Swirl Sunburst
items.description: Retro cream and orange bands sweeping in from above. A WebGL shader backdrop; the sunburst preset of shader-swirl.

items.name: shader-swirl-tide
items.title: Shader Swirl Tide
items.description: Silky blue bands twisting into a deep navy whirlpool. A WebGL shader backdrop; the tide preset of shader-swirl.

items.name: shader-text-reveal
items.title: Text Reveal
items.description: Words appear one at a time: a flowing, halftone-textured light material fills the letters, then clears to clean white type before a dark wave removes the word. Drawn in WebGL over a transparent background.

items.name: shader-voronoi
items.title: Voronoi
items.description: Voronoi cells in two colors shift and re-tessellate, with dark gaps between them, drawn in WebGL.

items.name: shader-warp
items.title: Shader Warp
items.description: Domain-warped color field that folds and stretches like liquid. A WebGL shader backdrop.

items.name: shader-warp-acid
items.title: Shader Warp Acid
items.description: Loud lime and cyan fluid swirling over black. A WebGL shader backdrop; the acid preset of shader-warp.

items.name: shader-warp-cream
items.title: Shader Warp Cream
items.description: Soft peach-to-coral cream gradient with a gentle drift. A WebGL shader backdrop; the cream preset of shader-warp.

items.name: shader-warp-deep-sea
items.title: Shader Warp Deep Sea
items.description: Diagonal teal bands rippling through midnight blue. A WebGL shader backdrop; the deep-sea preset of shader-warp.

items.name: shader-warp-marble
items.title: Shader Warp Marble
items.description: Cream and charcoal marble veins swirling together. A WebGL shader backdrop; the marble preset of shader-warp.

items.name: shader-warp-ocean
items.title: Shader Warp Ocean
items.description: Glossy aqua currents traced with dark ink edges. A WebGL shader backdrop; the ocean preset of shader-warp.

items.name: shader-warp-rose-gold
items.title: Shader Warp Rose Gold
items.description: Satin rose-gold folds with a soft sheen. A WebGL shader backdrop; the rose-gold preset of shader-warp.

items.name: shader-warp-silk
items.title: Shader Warp Silk
items.description: Violet and pink liquid silk folding in slow waves. A WebGL shader backdrop; the silk preset of shader-warp.

items.name: shader-warp-storm
items.title: Shader Warp Storm
items.description: Deep violet and lavender storm of marbled fluid. A WebGL shader backdrop; the storm preset of shader-warp.

items.name: shader-warp-sunset
items.title: Shader Warp Sunset
items.description: Marbled coral, peach and wine flowing like warm liquid. A WebGL shader backdrop; the sunset preset of shader-warp.

items.name: shader-water
items.title: Water
items.description: Caustic light ripples across a dark water surface with gentle refraction, drawn in WebGL.

items.name: shader-weave
items.title: Weave
items.description: Warp and weft threads interlace on a gently warped grid while a slow sheen of light travels across the cloth, drawn in WebGL. An accent color can run through the threads.

items.name: shadow-sweep-text
items.title: Shadow Sweep Text
items.description: A rising line is uncovered and removed by two dense dark shadow sweeps.

items.name: shadow-text
items.title: Shadow Text
items.description: Every letter casts a long, soft shadow that swings across the line as the sun crosses the sky, long and low at the edges, short at noon.

items.name: share-sheet-carousel
items.title: Share Sheet Carousel
items.description: A share sheet springs up over a blurred backdrop, its preview cycling through four slides in quick cuts, then the Accept button is pressed.

items.name: shared-axis-y
items.title: Shared Axis Y
items.description: A per-word hard-cut staircase: the old phrase snaps off word by word, then the new phrase snaps on word by word, with no fade or motion. A sharp editorial swap.

items.name: shared-axis-z
items.title: Shared Axis Z
items.description: A depth swap between two phrases: the old one scales up, blurs and fades away while the new one rises from a smaller scale and sharpens into focus, like a camera push forward.

items.name: sheen-slide-in
items.title: Sheen Slide In
items.description: A title glides in from the right with a long settle while a gradient sheen sweeps through the glyphs.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A side panel: a pointer clicks a trigger inside a mock app window, the scrim dims it and a panel slides in from the right; clicking Save closes it.

items.name: shimmer-sweep
items.title: Shimmer Sweep
items.description: A bright shine travels once across muted text, left to right: a refined metallic gleam that draws attention to text already on screen. It does not animate the text in.

items.name: shop-end-card
items.title: Shop End Card
items.description: The closing card of a small-shop video on a clean white page: a logo tile, the shop name, a tagline, address, opening hours, a contact line and a call-to-action button settle in one after another and hold still.

items.name: short-slide-down
items.title: Short Slide Down
items.description: Words drop in from above and stack into a centered multi-line composition.

items.name: short-slide-right
items.title: Short Slide Right
items.description: The whole phrase glides in from the left while words reveal in sequence through opacity.

items.name: shrink-burst-text
items.title: Shrink Burst Text
items.description: A word squeezes tight and trembles, then bursts into letters that fly outward, spin and fade; the word slides back up into place and the cycle repeats.

items.name: signup-flow
items.title: Signup Flow
items.description: A cursor-driven signup card: labeled Full Name, Email, Password and Confirm Password fields fill top to bottom, then Create account runs hover, press, loading and success as a confirmation toast slides in.

items.name: simulated-cursor
items.title: Simulated Cursor
items.description: A synthetic mouse cursor that travels between waypoints and fires a click ripple, for narrating a UI on screen.

items.name: sine-wave
items.title: Sine Wave
items.description: A glowing white sine wave travels across a black frame.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A shimmer placeholder that crossfades to the real content once it has loaded.

items.name: skeleton-block
items.title: Skeleton Block
items.description: A single shimmer placeholder rectangle whose highlight sweeps across it on a 2 second loop.

items.name: slide-swap
items.title: Slide Swap
items.description: Scenes swap on one canvas, never overlapping: the old scene is shoved off under power and the next one springs in and brakes into place. Plays three scenes (A, B, C). Built-in placeholder scenes A, B and C (the three .ssw-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it with your own scenes, replace the contents of those panels (each holds for 70 frames) and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A range slider whose thumb is picked up by the cursor and dragged from 20 to 80, with hover and press states on the thumb.

items.name: sliding-number
items.title: Sliding Number
items.description: A number whose digits each slide on their own spring reel to the next value in a list, shortest way round, with places appearing and disappearing as the length changes.

items.name: slot-machine-roll
items.title: Slot Machine Roll
items.description: Each character sits on its own vertical reel and springs from the old value to the new one, one column after another, like a casino drum. Values of different lengths are right-aligned.

items.name: smoke-dissolve
items.title: Smoke Dissolve
items.description: A ring of smoke expands from the center of the frame and the incoming scene materializes out of it. Rebuilt with a deterministic Canvas 2D noise field instead of the original WebGL shader. The block draws its own colored field between two built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .smd-panel elements); to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: social-post-card
items.title: Social Post Card
items.description: A dark social post card (avatar, name, handle, text with a hashtag, timestamp and metrics) rises in, gets a springy like with a pink heart and a count change, then drops out.

items.name: soft-blur-in
items.title: Soft Blur In
items.description: Per-character fade-in with a gentle blur and upward motion: an airy, soft premium reveal.

items.name: sparkles-text
items.title: Sparkles Text
items.description: Bold text with four-point stars that twinkle in and out at random spots over the letters, in two colours.

items.name: speaker-label-captions
items.title: Speaker Label Captions
items.description: A multi-speaker caption track: each line sits on a card with the speaker's name and colour, speakers alternate sides, and the previous line stays as quiet context.

items.name: speed-lines
items.title: Speed Lines
items.description: Comic-style motion streaks: a squashing ball leaves a trail as it lands, or rays rush out from a focus point.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A deterministic spinning arc: a rounded stroke that turns once every 60 frames at speed 1.

items.name: spinning-text
items.title: Spinning Text
items.description: Text set on a circle that turns steadily like a rotating badge or seal.

items.name: spiral-galaxy
items.title: Spiral Galaxy
items.description: A spiral galaxy of 20,000 additive stars: differential rotation winds the arms over time, the core glows warm and the rim fades to cold. Drawn with WebGL points over a dark backdrop with a soft rim-coloured halo.

items.name: split-screen-compare
items.title: Split Screen Compare
items.description: Two columns, Kami against Biasanya. Rows tick in on our side with a drawn check and cross out on theirs, staggered. Each row is one line of the rows variable: our text, then theirs.

items.name: split-text
items.title: Split Text
items.description: A pointer sweeps along a word and each letter it touches splits along its middle: the top half lifts and the bottom half drops, and the neighbours part by less.

items.name: split-text-chars
items.title: Split Text Chars
items.description: Splits a string into characters, words or lines and staggers them in with a fade-up, fade, scale or blur.

items.name: spoiler-text
items.title: Spoiler Text
items.description: A phrase in a sentence hides under a shimmering field of specks, then a wave blows them away and the words come into focus.

items.name: spotlight
items.title: Spotlight
items.description: A soft stage spotlight searches the dark, overshoots, lands on the logo, and the house lights come up. The placeholder lockup is a stand-in: a host swaps in its own logo by editing the .sp-logo element.

items.name: spring-scale-in
items.title: Spring Scale In
items.description: Words pop in with a soft overshoot scale, like a spring settling into place.

items.name: spring-settle
items.title: Spring Settle
items.description: Scenes leave as one group, shrinking and fading, then the stage changes color on an empty beat and the next scene's items spring in staggered from slightly oversized. Plays three scenes (A, B, C). Built-in placeholder scenes A, B and C (the three .ssl-scene elements, whose .ssl-item children settle in one after another) make it preview on its own; to use it with your own scenes, replace the contents of those scenes, give the elements that should settle in the class ssl-item, and set each scene's stage color in the SCENES list in the script.

items.name: squeeze-in
items.title: Squeeze In
items.description: Characters are uncovered one by one by a clean wipe, then the whole word squeezes tighter as the last one lands.

items.name: squiggle
items.title: Squiggle
items.description: A wavy, zigzag, looping or coiled line draws itself with a springy swim, settles, holds and erases.

items.name: srt-caption-track
items.title: SRT Caption Track
items.description: Renders captions straight from SubRip or WebVTT text: each cue is spread across its words, grouped into pages, and the spoken word is highlighted.

items.name: stage
items.title: Stage
items.description: A long page on a perspective studio plane, with the camera travelling across it on keyframes. The plane holds a built-in placeholder page drawn in CSS; to use your own, replace the markup inside #st-page in the file (it is 1265 wide and 5000 tall, scaled to the plane).

items.name: staggered-fade-up
items.title: Staggered Fade Up
items.description: Words slide up and fade in one after another in a wave-like cascade: a neutral, versatile headline reveal.

items.name: staggered-letter
items.title: Staggered Letter
items.description: Letters drop in from far above (or rise from far below) one by one and snap into place on a quick spring, over a pale ghost of the word.

items.name: stairs-column-reveal
items.title: Stairs Column Reveal
items.description: Five full-height columns grow down from the top in a right-to-left stagger to cover the frame, then drop away off the bottom in a second stagger while the next scene scales in from 120 percent.

items.name: stat-count-up-bars
items.title: Stat Count-up With Bars
items.description: A muted label and a giant figure counting up in tight black type with a unit under it, then a bar chart whose bars grow while their values count (the last one in the accent colour, the rest in light grey), then a percent ring that draws itself with its figure and a few words beside it. White page.

items.name: stat-trio
items.title: Stat Trio
items.description: Three stats count up side by side (stacked in a vertical frame), staggered, each with its label and an accent underline that draws in beneath it. Values like 1.200+, 4,9 or 98% keep their prefix, suffix and decimals while they count.

items.name: step-explainer
items.title: Step Explainer
items.description: A how-to with three numbered steps. A line draws from one numbered circle to the next, each step appears in turn with a small drawn icon, a title and a short detail. Vertical in a portrait frame, horizontal in a landscape one. Steps and their icons come from one variable.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: A multi-step progress indicator: circles fill, check marks draw and connectors fill as the position advances.

items.name: store-location-pin
items.title: Store Location Pin
items.description: An abstract map (a light street grid drawn with SVG lines, no real geography) draws itself, a pin drops and settles with a small bounce, then an address card rises with the shop name, street and opening hours.

items.name: stretch-in
items.title: Stretch In
items.description: Letters fly in from off-canvas and smear horizontally on the way: a vertex-lag deformation, not a scale.

items.name: strikethrough-replace
items.title: Strikethrough Replace
items.description: A strike line is drawn through the old text, then the new text fades in: an editorial correction.

items.name: string-art
items.title: String Art
items.description: Threads are strung around a ring of pins as a times table, then the multiplier morphs the figure from a cardioid through a nephroid and beyond.

items.name: stripe-type
items.title: Stripe Type
items.description: A word cut into horizontal bands, as in the IBM logo, slides together from alternating sides and locks, then can pass on through.

items.name: stripes
items.title: Diagonal Stripes
items.description: Bold black and white diagonal stripes slide across the frame.

items.name: stroke-to-fill-text
items.title: Stroke to Fill Text
items.description: Draws type as an outline, then floods each letter solid with a soft edge, in the direction you choose.

items.name: subtitle-translate
items.title: Subtitle Translate
items.description: Dual-language stacked subtitles: the lead line arrives first, the translation follows a few frames later in a smaller, quieter size, with optional language tags.

items.name: supporter-grid
items.title: Supporter Grid
items.description: A thank-you lockup for backers: a heart draws itself, pulses and docks upward while supporter avatars blur-stagger into a grid, then a headline, a supporter count and a call-to-action pill arrive.

items.name: sustained-glitch
items.title: Sustained Glitch
items.description: A scene that breaks up in short, scheduled bursts: torn slices, jumped blocks, red/blue channel split, then clean again until the next burst a second or so later. Runs its WebGL shader over its own built-in scene (a stat and a bar chart; label, number and bars from variables), not over the host video. The bursts are seeded, so the same seed breaks up at the same frames every render.

items.name: swirl-dissolve
items.title: Swirl Dissolve
items.description: A rotating swirl of color bands unwinds to open and winds shut again, and the incoming scene grows out of its center. Rebuilt with a deterministic Canvas 2D field instead of the original WebGL shader. The block draws its own colored field between two built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .swd-panel elements); to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: swirl-vortex
items.title: Swirl Vortex
items.description: Both scenes swirl in opposite directions with FBM-warped spiral path. Organic distortion. Plays between two built-in panels (A and B) that a host swaps for its own scenes: copy the fragment shader into your composition and feed it your two frames as textures.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A switch that a pointer flips: the track fills with the primary color while the thumb slides across.

items.name: swoosh-text
items.title: Swoosh Text
items.description: Extruded letters lit by a moving light: the 3D extrusion swings and overshoots as a cursor sweeps past, then a letter is pressed down like a keycap.

items.name: synthwave
items.title: Synthwave
items.description: A retro neon horizon with a scrolling perspective grid, a rising striped sun and mountain ranges that slide in. The grid keeps scrolling for as long as the clip lasts.

items.name: system-notification
items.title: System Notification
items.description: A frosted notification banner with an app icon, title and message slides in from the right and leaves again.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: A tab bar: a pointer clicks each tab in turn, the indicator slides to it, the label darkens and the panel text cross-fades.

items.name: terminal-cursor-zoom
items.title: Terminal Cursor Zoom
items.description: Camera locked to the typing cursor, dollying across a terminal as one command types at high zoom.

items.name: terminal-simulator
items.title: Terminal Simulator
items.description: A console window that types out commands line by line, shows logs, success and error lines, and snaps older lines off the top as the buffer fills.

items.name: text-3d-flip
items.title: Text 3D Flip
items.description: Every letter is a small rotating prism: the letters roll over one after another with a spring, a second identical face coming round to the front.

items.name: text-along-path
items.title: Text Along Path
items.description: Letters of a repeating phrase run endlessly along an SVG path, by default a rounded rectangle that frames the picture; supply your own path to make it follow any curve.

items.name: text-animate
items.title: Text Animate
items.description: One text block with ten entrance presets (fade, blur, slide, scale) that play by whole text, word, character or line, staggered.

items.name: text-animator
items.title: Text Animator
items.description: After Effects style text animator: a range selector sweeps across the characters, words or lines and drives position, scale, rotation, skew, opacity, blur, tracking and fill colour of what it covers.

items.name: text-effect
items.title: Text Effect
items.description: Text enters piece by piece with a preset (blur, fade-in-blur, scale, fade, slide) split per character, per word or per line, with the source's stagger times, and can leave in reverse.

items.name: text-explode
items.title: Text Burst Explode
items.description: A heavy word grows in, then bursts: every letter flies outward at its own angle while spinning and fading, and a thin shockwave ring expands behind them.

items.name: text-gradient
items.title: Flowing Gradient Text
items.description: A huge word filled with a restrained blue gradient that keeps rotating through the letters while the word scales and fades in; three short dashes can fade in below.

items.name: text-highlighter
items.title: Text Highlighter
items.description: Marked phrases in a paragraph get a highlighter fill that wipes across them (left to right, right to left, top down or bottom up), one phrase after another, wrapping correctly across lines.

items.name: text-kinetic
items.title: Kinetic Bounce Type
items.description: Letters spring up from below one after another, scaling in from nothing, and then keep dancing: each bobs and tilts on its own slow sine while an accent underline draws beneath.

items.name: text-loop
items.title: Text Loop
items.description: A list of words or phrases takes turns in one spot: the current one slides up and fades out while the next slides in from below, on a fixed interval, round and round.

items.name: text-mask-video
items.title: Text Mask Video
items.description: An animated gradient plays inside the letterforms, with a wipe reveal and a slow drifting pan and zoom.

items.name: text-morph
items.title: Text Morph
items.description: One word turns into the next by letter identity: letters the two words share glide to their new places on a spring while new letters fade in and the leftover ones fade out.

items.name: text-reveal
items.title: Text Reveal
items.description: A paragraph in faint type that lights up word by word to full colour, like text being read aloud or scrolled into focus.

items.name: text-roll
items.title: Text Roll
items.description: Every letter rolls over like a rotating drum: the front face tips away on the X axis while the same letter swings in from below, one letter after another, then the roll repeats.

items.name: text-rotate
items.title: Text Rotate
items.description: A fixed phrase followed by a pill that cycles through a list of words: the old word's letters slide up and out, the pill springs to the new width and the next word's letters rise in, with a staggered wave.

items.name: text-shimmer-wave
items.title: Text Shimmer Wave
items.description: A wave of light runs through muted text: each letter in turn lifts toward the viewer, tilts, grows slightly and brightens, then settles back, and the wave repeats.

items.name: text-split
items.title: Split Line Reveal
items.description: Two big left-aligned words arrive from opposite directions, one dropping in from above and one rising from below, while a rule draws across the gap and a thin vertical line grows at the right.

items.name: thermal-distortion
items.title: Thermal Distortion
items.description: FBM-driven heat shimmer rising from the bottom. Sine displacement modulated by noise with warm haze. Plays between two built-in panels (A and B) that a host swaps for its own scenes: copy the fragment shader into your composition and feed it your two frames as textures.

items.name: thin-film
items.title: Thin Film Orb
items.description: An orb's rim shimmers with soap-bubble iridescence on black.

items.name: tiny-planet
items.title: Tiny Planet
items.description: A seeded flat skyline bends into a tiny planet through a polar remap, then keeps turning beside a red sun.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A notification that slides in from below after a button click, holds, then auto-dismisses.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: A segmented control whose thumb slides between segments as the cursor clicks Yearly, then Monthly.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A small floating label that appears next to a button as the cursor hovers it, then fades away.

items.name: top-down-letters
items.title: Top-Down Letters
items.description: Letters descend from above in a pronounced staircase, one symbol at a time, with no blur: a sharp, graphic title.

items.name: topo-lines
items.title: Topo Lines
items.description: Topographic contour lines around a few seeded peaks breathe and drift, with index contours and one line picked out in the accent, as a seamless loop.

items.name: tracking-in
items.title: Tracking In
items.description: Wide letter-spacing collapses to tight while blur clears, on a spring: the word focuses into place.

items.name: trim-burst
items.title: Trim Burst
items.description: Short strokes shoot outward from a point and shrink to nothing: a quick spark, pop or impact accent.

items.name: truchet-flip
items.title: Truchet Flip
items.description: A grid of quarter-circle tiles flips in waves, then settles into a clean pattern: rings, a field or a silhouette.

items.name: turning-squares-disc
items.title: Turning Squares Disc
items.description: Inside a round window, a lattice of squares turns a quarter turn while two interleaved sets slide in opposite directions; then the colours swap, the dark squares become light on an accent field, and it turns again, looping seamlessly.

items.name: turntable
items.title: Turntable
items.description: A product card with real thickness spins on an invisible turntable through front, edge and back, with face shading, a moving sheen and a floor shadow. The faces are placeholders; a host puts its own content in the .tt-front and .tt-back markup in the script.

items.name: tv-power-off
items.title: TV Power Off
items.description: Ends a scene like a switched-off tube: the picture squashes into a bright horizontal line, the line pinches to a phosphor dot, the dot fades and the frame is dead black. Runs its WebGL shader over its own built-in scene (a render queue list; title, rows and background from variables), not over the host video. Plays once: 25 frames of picture, an 18-frame collapse, then black.

items.name: type-fossil
items.title: Type Fossil
items.description: A readable word carries layers of fine contours, revises itself through earlier drafts, then compresses into a clean typographic imprint.

items.name: type-repeater
items.title: Type Repeater
items.description: An After Effects style repeater on a word, where copies unfold into a tunnel, a spiral or a fan behind it, breathe, then fold back into the word.

items.name: type-wall
items.title: Type Wall
items.description: Rows of one word fill the frame, run in alternating directions at different speeds in heavy, narrow and outline faces, with an accent band through the middle.

items.name: typed-split-wipe
items.title: Typed Split Wipe
items.description: A centered cursorless type build exits through opposing fixed-layout glyph wipes.

items.name: typewriter
items.title: Typewriter
items.description: Text is typed out character by character at a steady rate, followed by a bar cursor that blinks once typing stops.

items.name: typing-animation
items.title: Typing Animation
items.description: Words are typed out one after another with a blinking cursor, each deleted faster than it was typed before the next begins.

items.name: typing-indicator
items.title: Typing Indicator
items.description: Bouncing dots that signal a reply is being composed, driven by staggered sine waves: a small continuous working-on-it motion that never resolves.

items.name: ui-3d-reveal
items.title: 3D UI Reveal
items.description: A logo mark draws on, then a design-tool window (layers, canvas, properties) flies in flat, pushes in, tilts into 3D and flies away, ending on a logo, tagline and link pill.

items.name: underwater-ripple
items.title: Underwater Ripple
items.description: A scene seen from under moving water: three crossing wave fields refract the picture and split its colour a little at every ripple. The ripple closes on a whole number of cycles across the block, so it loops cleanly. Runs its WebGL shader over its own built-in scene (a stat and a bar chart; label, number and bars from variables), not over the host video.

items.name: us-map
items.title: US Map
items.description: Animated US choropleth by state: states pop in from the centre, abbreviations appear, then the top states glow in turn.

items.name: us-map-bubble
items.title: US Bubble Map
items.description: US map with proportional bubbles that pop in one by one, callouts for the biggest, and connecting arcs from one hub.

items.name: us-map-flow
items.title: US Flow Map
items.description: Dark US map where city dots appear, glowing arcs draw between them and light dots travel along each route.

items.name: value-swap
items.title: Value Swap
items.description: Swap a value in place with a vertical slide so the layout never shifts.

items.name: variable-font-morph
items.title: Variable Font Morph
items.description: Sweeps a variable font's weight and width axes across a line, one character at a time, so the type swells and slims in a wave.

items.name: variant-picker
items.title: Variant Picker
items.description: A product card with colour swatches and sizes: a cursor taps one colour and one size, the product shape changes tint, a ring moves to the chosen swatch and the chosen size fills. Product, price, colours, sizes and the two choices are variables.

items.name: venetian-blinds
items.title: Venetian Blinds
items.description: The outgoing scene is cut into horizontal slats that turn edge-on one after another, like blinds opening onto the next scene. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .vnb-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: vertical-cut-reveal
items.title: Vertical Cut Reveal
items.description: Letters, words or whole lines slide up from behind an invisible cut line with a spring, staggered from the first, last, center or in random order; several lines follow one another.

items.name: vfx-anamorphic-flare
items.title: Anamorphic Streak Flare
items.description: A field of drifting coloured lights, each throwing a long horizontal anamorphic streak in a single tint: the look of a cinema lens flaring on city lights or bokeh. Canvas 2D, no WebGL.

items.name: vfx-liquid-background
items.title: Liquid Page Waves
items.description: A page floats on a liquid surface: vertex waves and ripples roll across it with a slight camera tilt, intensify, and the page crossfades into a second one while the surface settles to still. WebGL over two built-in pages.

items.name: vfx-magnetic
items.title: Magnetic Cursor
items.description: A page drawn through a WebGL shader that warps every pixel toward a moving cursor, with a Gaussian falloff and a little chromatic aberration, plus a repel pulse. Four captions explain what is happening.

items.name: vfx-portal
items.title: Portal Reveal
items.description: A landing page tears open from the centre in a glowing, colour-cycling portal and the dark theme of the same page is revealed behind it, with chromatic aberration and edge distortion along the rim. WebGL shader over two built-in pages (light and dark).

items.name: vfx-shatter
items.title: Glass Shatter
items.description: A glass shatter transition: a cracked-glass shader spreads from the centre of the first page, then 200 Voronoi shards break loose, fall with gravity and bounce while the second page is revealed behind them. WebGL over two built-in pages.

items.name: vfx-text-cursor
items.title: Text Cursor Rays
items.description: A wordmark rises into frame and a cursor sweeps across it, throwing prismatic light rays through the letters (a 112-sample ray accumulation shader); the mark shrinks away into a frosted glass card where a word is typed, slides into place, and the headline changes to a closing line.

items.name: vhs-filter
items.title: VHS Filter
items.description: A scene as recovered tape footage: colour smeared sideways off the brightness, the lines wobbling, a head-switch tear along the bottom edge, scanlines and grain. Runs its WebGL shader over its own built-in scene (a stat and a bar chart; label, number and bars from variables), not over the host video.

items.name: video-text
items.title: Video Text
items.description: Big bold letters used as a window onto moving imagery: here a drifting ocean-coloured gradient with soft moving light, visible only inside the letters.

items.name: voucher-ticket
items.title: Voucher Ticket
items.description: A discount ticket with notched, perforated edges slides in, the headline ("DISKON 20%") lands, and the stub tears off while its code reveals with a short scramble. Horizontal in landscape, stacked in portrait. Headline, code, note and shop are variables.

items.name: warp-dissolve
items.title: Warp Dissolve
items.description: The outgoing scene melts and blurs into a flowing, domain-warped color field that then resolves into the incoming scene. Rebuilt with a deterministic Canvas 2D noise field instead of the original WebGL shader. The block draws its own colored field between two built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .wpd-panel elements); to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: wave-reveal
items.title: Wave Reveal
items.description: Letters (or words) drift into place from slightly above or below while a blur clears, each starting a beat after the last so a slow wave runs through the line.

items.name: wave-text
items.title: Wave Text
items.description: Runs a sine wave along a line of type, one character at a time: an ambient loop that never settles.

items.name: wave-wipe
items.title: Wave Wipe
items.description: A grainy gradient of waves drifts up the frame while the outgoing scene lifts away and the incoming scene rises from the bottom. Rebuilt with a deterministic Canvas 2D gradient instead of the original WebGL shader. The block draws its own colored field between two built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .wvw-panel elements); to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: waveform
items.title: Waveform Bars
items.description: Equalizer bars in a blue to pink gradient pulse across the middle of the frame, like an audio visualizer.

items.name: wavy-stroke-bands
items.title: Wavy Stroke Bands
items.description: Nine wavy lines, each drawn three times as a thick soft halo, a medium band and a core line, draw on and off in a staggered wave while their width swells and the colour shifts from one tone to another.

items.name: wavy-text
items.title: Wavy Text
items.description: Letters bob up and down in a continuous wave, each starting a beat after the one before, like a ripple running along the word.

items.name: whip-pan
items.title: Whip Pan
items.description: A fast directional cut: both scenes fly through the frame in one camera whip, with motion blur and a slight smear at peak speed. Plays between two placeholder panels.

items.name: word-push
items.title: Word Push
items.description: Words drive in from the right and push the line left into its new center.

items.name: word-roller-3d-carousel
items.title: Word Roller 3D Carousel
items.description: Words stand around a cylinder that spins in perspective: it starts slowly, spins fast, slows, and stops on the last word, which turns to the accent colour and grows while the others stay dim.

items.name: word-roller-blur
items.title: Word Roller Blur
items.description: A line of small caps over a big word: each word blurs in sharp from soft and fades while blurring away before the next one, and the last word stays crisp.

items.name: word-roller-countdown
items.title: Word Roller Countdown
items.description: A countdown that scrolls through its numbers, then a blurred, accelerating spin that lands on a launch word with a springy settle.

items.name: word-roller-dramatic-stop
items.title: Word Roller Dramatic Stop
items.description: A vertical roller that fakes you out: it eases almost to a stop on the wrong word, shudders, speeds up again and finally lands on the last word with a small bounce in the accent colour and two lines drawing out to its sides.

items.name: word-roller-drum
items.title: Word Roller Drum
items.description: A word cycles on the face of a rotating 3D drum beside a fixed prefix: each spring turn brings the next word round, and the last one stays.

items.name: word-roller-fade-slide
items.title: Word Roller Fade Slide
items.description: A left-aligned lead-in over a bold word that slides up from below as it fades in and drifts up as it leaves, with an accent underline that redraws on every word and a big faint counter on the right.

items.name: word-roller-glitch
items.title: Word Roller Glitch
items.description: A heavy uppercase word swaps with an RGB-split glitch: for eight frames a blue top half and a rose bottom half jitter sideways behind the word, then it holds clean until the next swap.

items.name: word-roller-gradient-wave
items.title: Word Roller Gradient Wave
items.description: Words swap one after another with their letters rising in, each letter shifting hue in a slow blue wave across the word, over a progress bar; the last word settles in the accent blue, a little bigger.

items.name: word-roller-liquid
items.title: Word Roller Liquid
items.description: A fat word melts into the next: in the last twelve frames of each cycle an SVG turbulence filter ripples the letters while the next word fades in underneath.

items.name: word-roller-mask-slide
items.title: Word Roller Mask Slide
items.description: A huge word is wiped away from the right by the next word in an accent colour, which slides in behind a moving mask; a thin progress line under the word fills over each cycle.

items.name: word-roller-multi-slot
items.title: Word Roller Multi Slot
items.description: Three slot-machine columns spin at once, each with its own word list, and stop one after another with a bounce, the landed words and column outlines turning to the accent colour.

items.name: word-roller-outline-highlight
items.title: Word Roller Outline Highlight
items.description: The same word stacked seven times as an outline; a solid, slightly larger copy travels down the stack, slow, then fast, then easing, and settles on the last row with a spring.

items.name: word-roller-perspective-stripes
items.title: Word Roller Perspective Stripes
items.description: Rows of a two-part phrase in two colours slide sideways at different speeds over a tilted plane that scrolls away in depth, while the phrase itself fades up large in the middle.

items.name: word-roller-scale-bounce
items.title: Word Roller Scale Bounce
items.description: A light lead-in beside a heavy word that pops in from nothing with a bouncy spring, shrinks away before the next, and the last one stays at full size.

items.name: word-roller-shuffle
items.title: Word Roller Shuffle
items.description: Every letter of a word flickers through random capitals and digits, then locks into its true letter from left to right with a small pop in the accent colour, while a bar below fills as letters are confirmed.

items.name: word-roller-slot-reveal
items.title: Word Roller Slot Reveal
items.description: A list of ten words scrolls through a masked window beside a fixed prefix: slow start, a fast stretch, then a very long, gentle slowdown onto the last word, which lands larger in the accent colour.

items.name: word-roller-split-flap
items.title: Word Roller Split Flap
items.description: An airport-style departure board where each word flips onto a row of flap tiles, letter by letter, through a list of places before it lands on a final word; a status line changes from searching to confirmed.

items.name: word-roller-typewriter
items.title: Word Roller Typewriter
items.description: A sentence with one coloured word that is deleted letter by letter and retyped as the next word, with a block cursor that keeps blinking at the end.

items.name: word-roller-wave
items.title: Word Roller Wave
items.description: A word is built from letters that rise one after another from below as they fade in, and leave by lifting out in a ripple, before the next word starts; the last word stays.

items.name: word-rotate
items.title: Word Rotate
items.description: A list of words takes turns in one spot: each fades out sliding down, the next fades in sliding down from above.

items.name: word-stream
items.title: Word Stream
items.description: Voiceover-paced phrases building word by word while the line drifts left.

items.name: workflow-console
items.title: Workflow Console
items.description: A 46.8-second release-automation film in navy and ice blue: a typed title, a command that types itself, terminal runs with tool calls, an environment carousel of node diagrams, a rollout response, pipeline metrics, a large recommendation with a camera push, a performance bar chart and a closing node mark. Silent: sound is added by the host. Commands, logs and metrics are fictional sample text.

items.name: world-map
items.title: World Map
items.description: Animated world choropleth: countries fade in from the centre outwards, colour by value, then the highest ones pulse.

items.name: x-ray-scan
items.title: X-Ray Scan
items.description: A glowing scanner bar sweeps across a device and reveals its white-line internals, with one part marked in red. A built-in phone stands in for the product; a host replaces the .xr-outside and .xr-inside layers with its own exterior and interior pictures.

items.name: zoom-blur
items.title: Zoom Blur
items.description: A quick cross-zoom: the outgoing scene swells and blurs out while the next scene scales up from slightly small and sharpens. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .zmb-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.

items.name: zoom-words
items.title: Zoom Words
items.description: Huge words fade into a long line while the camera rides the write head.
